title: Watermarks and Fingerprints as Soft Bindings for Content Provenance: An Open-Licence Benchmark for Images, Audio and Video
title_zh: 作为内容来源软绑定的水印与指纹：面向图像、音频和视频的开放许可基准测试

paragraphs.en: Content-provenance standards such as C2PA let a platform recover a stripped manifest through a soft binding: an invisible watermark read from the content, or a fingerprint looked up in a registry. We benchmarked both families under one protocol, restricted to openly available models whose licences we audited, on public media, with false-match rates calibrated on held-out negatives and source-level bootstrap intervals for performance estimates. For watermarking we evaluated 25 image, 7 audio and 7 video configurations from 12 methods on perceptual quality, robustness, false positives and cost; for fingerprinting, 35 methods on registries of up to 98,985 images, partial edits and adversarial attacks. PixelSeal gave the best balance for image and video watermarks and AudioSeal for audio, but the error-correcting detector of every TrustMark variant fired on 5.9 to 15.3% of unmarked images, so a verifier should test the expected payload. Among fingerprints, copy detectors trained on non-commercial data detected up to 75.5% of transformed images at a pair-level false-match rate of 10 − 7 10^{-7} and DINOv2, the best permissively licensed method, 65.0%; near-copies in a product catalogue dominated the false matches, and no detection improvement from geometric verification was observed under a matched calibration false-binding constraint in the evaluated image pipelines. On the same attacked copies the two families failed differently: the union of watermark and fingerprint successes covered 69% of image copies; fingerprints covered more audio queries, whereas expected-key watermark verification covered more video queries. Embedding a watermark moved the ISCC code of 62.0% of images past its match threshold, and platform-dependent colour conversion changed watermark bits between x86 and ARM hosts.
paragraphs.zh: C2PA 等内容来源标准允许平台通过软绑定恢复被剥离的元数据清单：即从内容中读取的隐形水印，或从注册表中查询到的指纹。 我们采用统一协议对这两类方法进行了基准测试，测试范围限于许可协议经过审计且公开可用的模型，测试对象为公共媒体；假匹配率通过预留的负样本进行校准，性能估计则基于源级自举区间。 在水印方面，我们从 12 种方法中评估了 25 种图像、7 种音频和 7 种视频配置，考察其感知质量、鲁棒性、假阳性率和成本；在指纹方面，则在包含多达 98,985 张图像、部分编辑内容以及对抗性攻击的注册表中测试了 35 种方法。 PixelSeal 在图像和视频水印中实现了最佳平衡性，AudioSeal 则在音频中表现最佳；但所有 TrustMark 变体的纠错检测器都会对 5.9% 至 15.3% 的未标记图像触发警报，因此验证者应测试预期的有效载荷。 在指纹方法中，基于非商业数据训练的复制检测器在每对样本的假匹配率为 10^{-7} 时，能够检测到高达 75.5% 的经转换的图像；而许可最宽松的最佳方法 DINOv2 的检测率为 65.0%。产品目录中的近似副本是假匹配的主要来源，并且在所评估的图像处理流程中，在匹配校准的假绑定约束条件下，几何验证并未带来检测能力的提升。 在相同的受攻击副本上，这两类方法的失效表现不同：水印与指纹检测成功的并集覆盖了 69% 的图像副本；指纹方法覆盖的音频查询更多，而基于预期密钥的水印验证则覆盖了更多的视频查询。 嵌入水印会使 62.0% 图像的 ISCC 码超出其匹配阈值，而依赖平台的颜色转换还会导致 x86 和 ARM 主机之间的水印位发生变化。

paragraphs.en: Keywords: content provenance, C2PA, soft binding, invisible watermarking, content fingerprinting, copy detection, false positives, robustness, benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: 关键词：内容来源、C2PA、软绑定、隐形水印、内容指纹识别、复制检测、误报、鲁棒性、基准测试。

paragraphs.en: Content provenance standards attach a signed record of origin and edits to a media file. The C2PA specification [ 1 ] binds that record to the file cryptographically, so the binding holds only as long as the bytes do. Re-encoding, resizing, a screenshot or a platform’s upload pipeline strips or invalidates the manifest, and the content then circulates without its history. C2PA therefore defines soft bindings : identifiers derived from the content that let anyone holding a copy look the manifest up again. A soft binding is either an invisible watermark , which carries a key inside the pixels or samples, or a fingerprint , which is computed from the content and matched against a registry. Regulation adds a second reason to put a signal into the content itself: Article 50(2) of the EU Artificial Intelligence Act requires providers of generative systems to mark synthetic audio, images, video and text in a machine-readable, detectable form, with solutions that are effective, interoperable, robust and reliable as far as technically feasible [ 2 , 3 ] . Neither the standard nor the regulation prescribes a method or a performance threshold.
paragraphs.zh: 内容来源标准会在媒体文件中附加一份带有签名的来源和编辑记录。 C2PA 规范 [ 1 ] 通过加密方式将该记录与文件绑定，因此这种绑定仅在文件字节未改变的情况下有效。 重新编码、调整尺寸、截图或平台的上传流程都会移除或使该元数据失效，此后内容便脱离其历史背景传播。 因此，C2PA 定义了“软绑定”：即从内容中派生出的标识符，让任何持有副本的人都能再次查询到该元数据。 “软绑定”可以是隐形水印（在像素或采样点内部携带密钥），也可以是指纹（根据内容计算得出并与注册表进行匹配）。 法规为此增添了第二个理由：欧盟《人工智能法》第 50(2) 条要求生成式系统的提供者以机器可读且可检测的形式标记合成音频、图像、视频和文本，相关解决方案在技术可行的范围内必须有效、互操作、稳健且可靠 [ 2 , 3 ]。 该标准与法规均未规定具体方法或性能阈值。

paragraphs.en: The two families are complementary. A watermark answers directly and needs no index, but it must be embedded before release, it can be removed, and it says nothing about content that was never marked. A fingerprint needs no change to the content and applies to an existing archive, but every lookup risks binding a query to the wrong asset, and that risk grows with the registry: a service holding millions of assets needs false-match rates per comparison of 10 − 7 10^{-7} or lower. For both families, the rate at which unmarked or unregistered content is reported as a match matters as much as robustness, because a false match attaches someone else’s provenance to a piece of content. That rate depends on the decision rule a verifier applies, not only on the model.
paragraphs.zh: 这两种方法是互补的。 水印可以直接响应且无需索引，但必须在发布前嵌入；它可被移除，并且对于从未被标记的内容无法提供任何信息。 指纹无需对内容做任何修改，并适用于现有存档；但每次查询都存在将查询错误地绑定到错误资产的风险，而这种风险会随注册表规模的扩大而增加：一个管理着数百万个资产的服务，其每次比较的误匹配率必须达到 10^{-7} 或更低。 对于这两种方法而言，未标记或未注册内容被报告为匹配的频率，与方法的稳健性同样重要，因为误匹配会将他人的来源信息错误地附加到某个内容上。 该频率取决于验证者所采用的决策规则，而不仅仅是模型本身。

sents.zh: 这两种方法是互补的。

paragraphs.en: Choosing either kind of soft binding is therefore an empirical question, and the published evidence is fragmented. Each new watermark is reported against baselines of its authors’ choosing, at its own embedding strength and with its own metrics [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 ] ; watermark benchmarks cover one modality each [ 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 ] . Copy-detection benchmarks rank learned descriptors by average precision without a fixed false-match rate [ 12 ] , perceptual-hash studies measure robustness to benign edits or, separately, to adversaries [ 13 , 14 ] , and the one open fingerprint on the C2PA soft-binding list, the ISCC of ISO 24138 [ 15 ] , has not been compared with either. Licences decide the matter for many adopters and differ between a paper and its release: the strongest learned image descriptors ship with weights trained on non-commercial data, and some watermark checkpoints carry no licence at all. Finally, the two families are evaluated separately, although a provenance service would deploy them together.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，选择这两种软绑定方式中的哪一种是一个经验性问题，而现有发表的证据则零散不全。 每个新的水印都需根据作者自行选择的基准线进行报告，并采用其自身的嵌入强度与指标 [4, 5, 6, 7]；水印基准测试则分别涵盖单一模态 [8, 9, 10, 11]。 复制检测基准测试通过平均精度对学习型描述符进行排名，但未设定固定的误匹配率 [12]；感知哈希研究则衡量其对良性编辑或对抗性修改的鲁棒性 [13, 14]；而 C2PA 软绑定列表中唯一公开的指纹方案——ISO 24138 标准中的 ISCC [15]——尚未与上述任何方法进行比较。 对于许多采用者而言，许可协议决定了最终选择，且同一论文的原始版本与发布版本之间可能存在差异：最强的学习型图像描述符通常附带在非商业数据上训练的权重，而某些水印检查点甚至完全不附带许可协议。 最后，这两类方法被分别进行评估，尽管在实际应用中，溯源服务会将它们一同部署。

paragraphs.en: This paper benchmarks openly available watermarks and fingerprints for images, audio and video under one protocol, designed around the decisions a provenance service must make. Our contributions are as follows.
paragraphs.zh: 本文根据溯源服务必须做出的决策，设计了一套统一协议，对公开可用的图像、音频和视频水印与指纹进行了基准测试。 我们的贡献如下。

sents.en: This paper benchmarks openly available watermarks and fingerprints for images, audio and video under one protocol, designed around the decisions a provenance service must make.
sents.zh: 本文根据溯源服务必须做出的决策，设计了一套统一协议，对公开可用的图像、音频和视频水印与指纹进行了基准测试。

sents.en: Our contributions are as follows.
sents.zh: 我们的贡献如下。

paragraphs.en: A watermarking track of 25 image, 7 audio and 7 video configurations from 12 methods on public, licence-audited media, measuring perceptual quality with display-aware metrics, robustness to 32 routine transformations with worst-subset reporting, payload recovery, false positives under blind and expected-payload decision rules, and embedding latency and estimated cloud cost (Sections 3.2 and 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在公共且经过许可审核的媒体上，采用12种方法对25种图像、7种音频和7种视频配置进行水印嵌入，通过显示感知指标衡量感知质量，评估其在32种常规变换下的鲁棒性（并报告最差子集情况），同时测试有效载荷恢复能力、在盲检和预期有效载荷决策规则下的误报率，以及嵌入延迟和预估云成本（第3.2节和第4节）。

paragraphs.en: A fingerprinting track of 21 image, 6 audio and 8 video methods with 79 transformations, a registry of about a hundred thousand images, and thresholds fixed on held-out negatives at query-level and registry-size-independent pair-level false-match rates down to 10 − 7 10^{-7} ; a partial-edit track with localization; a test of second-stage geometric verification; and white-box, transfer, forgery and inversion attacks (Sections 3.3 and 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 指纹识别任务包含21种图像方法、6种音频方法和8种视频方法，共涉及79种变换；一个包含约十万张图像的注册库；以及在查询级别和与注册库大小无关的成对错误匹配率方面，针对预留负样本设定的阈值固定为低至10^{-7}；一个带有定位功能的部分编辑任务；第二阶段几何验证测试；以及白盒、迁移、伪造和逆向攻击（第3.3节和第5节）。

paragraphs.en: A measurement of how the two families complement each other on identical media and attacks, and of how embedding a watermark moves fingerprints (Section 6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 衡量两个家族在相同媒介和攻击下如何相互补充，以及嵌入水印如何改变指纹（第 6 节）。

paragraphs.en: Statistics that treat the source item, not the transformed copy, as the independent unit, and two reproducibility findings: detector outputs that change between x86 and ARM hosts because colour conversion differs, and benchmark inputs that must be pinned beyond the corpus itself.
paragraphs.zh: 将源项而非转换后的副本视为独立单元的相关统计数据，以及两项可重复性发现：由于颜色转换存在差异，检测器在 x86 和 ARM 主机上的输出结果会发生变化；此外，基准测试的输入必须固定为语料库本身之外的特定内容。

paragraphs.en: Section 2 reviews related work, Section 3 describes the design shared by both tracks and each track’s protocol, Sections 4 – 6 report the results, and Section 7 discusses what they imply for a C2PA soft-binding service.
paragraphs.zh: 第 2 节回顾了相关研究，第 3 节描述了两个赛道共同采用的设计以及每个赛道的协议，第 4 至 6 节报告了研究结果，第 7 节则探讨了这些结果对 C2PA 软绑定服务的意义。

paragraphs.en: The C2PA Technical Specification 2.4 [ 1 ] binds a manifest to its asset with a cryptographic hard binding and optionally with one or more soft bindings : content identifiers that are either not statistically unique, such as a fingerprint, or embedded as an invisible watermark (Sec. 2.3.13). A fingerprint is defined as “a set of inherent properties computable from digital content that identifies the content or near duplicates of it” (Sec. 2.4.2). A soft binding is recorded in a c2pa.soft-binding assertion carrying an algorithm identifier, the value and optional scope (Sec. 18.10), and it lets a validator that holds content without a manifest query a repository through the Soft Binding Resolution API [ 16 ] . Version 2.4 states that the algorithm should be one named in the C2PA soft-binding algorithm list (Sec. 9.3.2) and that a soft binding shall not be used as a hard binding (Sec. 9.3.1). At the snapshot we used (commit 5c864efb , 16 September 2026) the list held 53 entries, 44 watermarks and 9 fingerprints [ 17 ] . Of the fingerprints, only ISCC ( io.iscc.v0 ) is an open, multi-modal standard [ 15 ] ; the others are proprietary services or, in one case, a cryptographic digest registered as a soft binding. Collomosse and Parsons describe the combination of manifest, watermark and fingerprint as the three pillars of durable provenance [ 18 ] , and Adobe’s deep image comparator [ 19 ] and SImProv [ 20 ] combine retrieval with localization of the edited region; neither is released as code.
paragraphs.zh: C2PA 技术规格 2.4 [ 1 ] 通过加密强绑定将清单与其资产关联，并可选地通过一个或多个弱绑定进行关联：这些内容标识符要么在统计上不具有唯一性（例如指纹），要么以不可见水印的形式嵌入（第 2.3.13 节）。 指纹被定义为“可从数字内容中计算得出的一组固有属性，用于识别该内容或其近乎完全相同的副本”（第 2.4.2 节）。 弱绑定记录在 c2pa.soft-binding 断言中，包含算法标识符、值以及可选的作用域（第 18.10 节）；持有无清单内容的验证器可以通过“弱绑定解析 API”[ 16 ] 向存储库发起查询。 版本 2.4 规定，所用算法必须为 C2PA 弱绑定算法列表中命名的算法之一（第 9.3.2 节），且弱绑定不得被用作强绑定（第 9.3.1 节）。 在我们使用的快照（提交 5c864efb，2026 年 9 月 16 日）中，该列表包含 53 个条目，其中 44 个为水印，9 个为指纹 [ 17 ]。 在这些指纹中，只有 ISCC（io.iscc.v0）是开放的多模态标准 [ 15 ]；其余均为专有服务，或在一个案例中作为注册为弱绑定的加密摘要。 Collomosse 和 Parsons 将清单、水印与指纹的结合称为持久来源追溯的三大支柱 [ 18 ]；Adobe 的深度图像比较器 [ 19] 和 SImProv [ 20] 则将内容检索与编辑区域的定位相结合，但两者均未以代码形式发布。

paragraphs.en: Article 50(2) of the EU Artificial Intelligence Act requires providers of systems that generate synthetic audio, image, video or text to ensure that outputs are marked in a machine-readable format and detectable as artificially generated or manipulated. The technical solutions must be effective, interoperable, robust and reliable as far as technically feasible [ 2 ] . The Digital Omnibus on AI, in force since 27 July 2026, postponed this marking obligation to 2 December 2026 for systems placed on the market before 2 August 2026 [ 3 ] . The Act does not name a technique or set thresholds. Imperceptibility, survival under processing, false-positive rate and cost are therefore left to evidence of the kind a comparative benchmark provides.
paragraphs.zh: 《欧盟人工智能法》第 50(2) 条要求，提供可生成合成音频、图像、视频或文本系统的供应商，必须确保其输出以机器可读的格式进行标记，并能被识别为人工生成或篡改的内容。 这些技术解决方案必须在技术可行的范围内具备有效性、互操作性、稳健性和可靠性 [ 2 ] 。 自 2026 年 7 月 27 日起生效的《人工智能数字综合法案》将这一标记义务推迟至 2026 年 12 月 2 日，适用于在 2026 年 8 月 2 日之前投放市场的系统 [ 3 ] 。 该法案并未指定具体技术或设定阈值。 因此，不可察觉性、处理过程中的存续能力、误报率以及成本等问题，需依赖比较基准所提供的证据来加以判断。

paragraphs.en: Cox et al. introduced spread-spectrum watermarking for multimedia, spreading a pseudo-random sequence over perceptually significant transform coefficients so that the mark cannot be removed without degrading the host [ 21 ] . Later transform-domain schemes embedded the mark in the DCT domain with a detector that does not need the original image [ 22 ] , or combined the discrete wavelet transform with singular value decomposition [ 23 ] . The DWT-DCT and DWT-DCT-SVD encoders of the invisible-watermark library [ 24 ] are open implementations in this family. Their documentation warns that decoding is not guaranteed even on unmodified images.
paragraphs.zh: Cox 等人提出了用于多媒体的扩频水印技术，将伪随机序列扩散到感知上重要的变换系数中，从而使得在破坏宿主信号质量的情况下无法移除该标记 [21]。 后来的变换域方案则将标记嵌入 DCT 域，并采用无需原始图像的检测器 [22]，或者将离散小波变换与奇异值分解相结合 [23]。 不可见水印库中的 DWT-DCT 和 DWT-DCT-SVD 编码器 [24] 是该系列技术的开放实现。 其文档警告称，即使在对未修改的图像上，解码也无法得到保证。

paragraphs.en: Deep watermarking replaced hand-designed transforms with learned encoders and decoders. HiDDeN trained both networks jointly and showed that the encodings can be made robust to noise applied between them [ 25 ] . StegaStamp extended the idea to printed and re-photographed images [ 26 ] , and MBRS handled non-differentiable JPEG compression by mixing real and simulated compression within each mini-batch [ 27 ] . RivaGAN added an attention-based embedder and two adversarial critics, one for visual quality and one for robustness, and was designed for video [ 28 ] . RoSteALS moved embedding into the latent space of a frozen pretrained autoencoder [ 29 ] . TrustMark, a GAN-based method with spatio-spectral losses, targets images of arbitrary resolution and adds a network that removes its own watermark for re-watermarking [ 4 ] . InvisMark was designed for high-resolution generated images and reports a PSNR near 51 dB, an SSIM near 0.998 and 256-bit payloads [ 5 ] . The Watermark Anything Model (WAM) segments an image into watermarked and unwatermarked regions and recovers several 32-bit messages from small areas [ 30 ] . Pixel Seal replaces pixel-wise perceptual losses with adversarial-only training, stabilizes it with a three-stage schedule, and applies just-noticeable-difference attenuation at high resolution [ 6 ] . Petrov et al. derived upper bounds on watermark capacity under PSNR and linear robustness constraints and trained ChunkySeal, a scaled version of Video Seal that carries 1024 bits [ 31 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 深度水印技术用可学习的编码器和解码器取代了手动设计的变换方法。 HiDDeN 联合训练了两个网络，并证明了编码结果能够抵抗两者之间施加的噪声 [ 25 ] 。 StegaStamp 将这一思路扩展到印刷后再重新拍摄的图片 [ 26 ] ，而 MBRS 则通过在每个迷你批次中混合真实压缩和模拟压缩来处理不可微分的 JPEG 压缩 [ 27 ] 。 RivaGAN 增加了一个基于注意力的嵌入器以及两个对抗性评判器（一个用于视觉质量，另一个用于鲁棒性），并且专为视频设计 [ 28 ] 。 RoSteALS 将嵌入过程转移到了一个冻结的预训练自编码器的潜在空间中 [ 29 ] 。 TrustMark 是一种基于 GAN 的方法，采用空间-光谱损失函数，适用于任意分辨率的图片，并增加了一个用于移除自身水印以便重新打水的网络 [ 4 ] 。 InvisMark 专为高分辨率生成图片设计，报告了接近 51 dB 的 PSNR、接近 0.998 的 SSIM 以及 256 比特的有效载荷 [ 5 ] 。 Watermark Anything Model（WAM）将图片分割为带有水印和没有水印的区域，并能够从小区域中恢复多个 32 比特的消息 [ 30 ] 。 Pixel Seal 用纯对抗性训练取代了逐像素的感知损失，通过三阶段训练计划来稳定模型，并在高分辨率下应用了“刚好可察觉差异”的衰减技术 [ 6 ] 。 Petrov 等人推导出了在 PSNR 和线性鲁棒性约束下水印容量的上界，并训练了 ChunkySeal——这是 Video Seal 的一个扩展版本，能够携带 1024 比特数据 [ 31 ] 。

sents.zh: 深度水印技术用可学习的编码器和解码器取代了手动设计的变换方法。

paragraphs.en: A separate line embeds the mark during generation. Stable Signature, for example, fine-tunes the latent decoder of a diffusion model, conditioned on a binary signature, so that every generated image carries it [ 32 ] . Such methods cannot mark existing content, so our study covers post-hoc methods only. Each of the papers above evaluates its method against baselines of its own choosing, on its own images, at its own embedding strength and with its own selection of metrics, mostly PSNR and SSIM. Their reported numbers are therefore not directly comparable.
paragraphs.zh: 在生成过程中，会单独插入一行以嵌入标记。 例如，Stable Signature 会对扩散模型的潜在解码器进行微调，并以二进制签名作为条件，从而确保每张生成的图像都包含该签名 [32]。 此类方法无法对现有内容进行标记，因此我们的研究仅涵盖事后处理方法。 上述每篇论文都按照自己选择的基线模型、自己的图像数据集、自己设定的嵌入强度以及自己选定的指标（主要是 PSNR 和 SSIM）来评估其方法。 因此，它们所报告的数值无法直接比较。

paragraphs.en: Hartung and Girod applied spread-spectrum embedding to both uncompressed and compressed video [ 33 ] . Among learned methods, DVMark uses a multiscale network for video watermarking [ 34 ] , and RivaGAN operates on frame sequences [ 28 ] . Video Seal trains an embedder and an extractor with video codecs among the training transformations. It also propagates the watermark temporally, so that an image model can be applied without watermarking every high-resolution frame [ 35 ] . Pixel Seal adapts to video by pooling the watermark over time [ 6 ] . In deployment, video is usually re-encoded with H.264/AVC [ 36 ] or H.265/HEVC [ 37 ] , and inter-frame prediction together with coarse quantization can attenuate low-energy residuals. Few video watermarking models have openly licensed weights, and independent evidence is thin: VideoMarkBench, the dedicated video benchmark discussed below, uses clips produced by video generators rather than camera footage [ 11 ] .
paragraphs.zh: Hartung 和 Girod 将扩频嵌入技术应用于未压缩和压缩视频 [ 33 ]。 在基于学习的方法中，DVMark 使用多尺度网络进行视频水印嵌入 [ 34 ]，而 RivaGAN 则针对帧序列进行操作 [ 28 ]。 Video Seal 通过视频编解码器对嵌入器和提取器进行训练，这些编解码器属于训练过程中的变换步骤之一。 该方法还会在时间维度上传播水印，因此无需对每一帧高分辨率图像都进行水印处理，即可应用图像模型 [ 35 ]。 Pixel Seal 通过在时间上对水印进行池化操作来适应视频 [ 6 ]。 在实际部署中，视频通常会使用 H.264/AVC [ 36 ] 或 H.265/HEVC [ 37 ] 重新编码，而帧间预测与粗略量化相结合会削弱低能量残差。 目前仅有少数视频水印模型公开了其权重，且独立证据也较为匮乏：下文讨论的专用视频基准 VideoMarkBench 使用的是视频生成器生成的片段，而非摄像头拍摄的真实画面 [ 11 ]。

sents.en: Hartung and Girod applied spread-spectrum embedding to both uncompressed and compressed video [ 33 ] .
sents.zh: Hartung 和 Girod 将扩频嵌入技术应用于未压缩和压缩视频 [ 33 ]。

sents.en: Among learned methods, DVMark uses a multiscale network for video watermarking [ 34 ] , and RivaGAN operates on frame sequences [ 28 ] .
sents.zh: 在基于学习的方法中，DVMark 使用多尺度网络进行视频水印嵌入 [ 34 ]，而 RivaGAN 则针对帧序列进行操作 [ 28 ]。

sents.en: Video Seal trains an embedder and an extractor with video codecs among the training transformations.
sents.zh: Video Seal 通过视频编解码器对嵌入器和提取器进行训练，这些编解码器属于训练过程中的变换步骤之一。

sents.en: It also propagates the watermark temporally, so that an image model can be applied without watermarking every high-resolution frame [ 35 ] .
sents.zh: 该方法还会在时间维度上传播水印，因此无需对每一帧高分辨率图像都进行水印处理，即可应用图像模型 [ 35 ]。

sents.en: Pixel Seal adapts to video by pooling the watermark over time [ 6 ] .
sents.zh: Pixel Seal 通过在时间上对水印进行池化操作来适应视频 [ 6 ]。

sents.en: In deployment, video is usually re-encoded with H.264/AVC [ 36 ] or H.265/HEVC [ 37 ] , and inter-frame prediction together with coarse quantization can attenuate low-energy residuals.
sents.zh: 在实际部署中，视频通常会使用 H.264/AVC [ 36 ] 或 H.265/HEVC [ 37 ] 重新编码，而帧间预测与粗略量化相结合会削弱低能量残差。

sents.en: Few video watermarking models have openly licensed weights, and independent evidence is thin: VideoMarkBench, the dedicated video benchmark discussed below, uses clips produced by video generators rather than camera footage [ 11 ] .
sents.zh: 目前仅有少数视频水印模型公开了其权重，且独立证据也较为匮乏：下文讨论的专用视频基准 VideoMarkBench 使用的是视频生成器生成的片段，而非摄像头拍摄的真实画面 [ 11 ]。

paragraphs.en: Bender et al. surveyed early data-hiding techniques for images and audio [ 38 ] , and Kirovski and Malvar adapted spread-spectrum watermarking to audio signals [ 39 ] . WavMark encodes up to 32 bits in each second of audio and reports a mean bit error rate of 0.48% over ten attacks on 10-20 s clips [ 40 ] . AudioSeal trains a generator and a detector with a localization loss for sample-level detection and uses a perceptual loss inspired by auditory masking; its single-pass detector is intended for large-scale screening [ 7 ] . SilentCipher adds psychoacoustic thresholding and pseudo-differentiable compression layers and operates on 44.1 kHz audio [ 41 ] . Perth is an open library whose main watermarker is a neural implicit model. Its documentation claims survival of compression and resampling, but no peer-reviewed evaluation is available [ 42 ] . WavMark and AudioSeal were motivated by voice cloning and evaluated mainly on speech, and the four methods use different native sample rates, so a shared protocol has to fix resampling and codec settings before their numbers can be compared.
paragraphs.zh: Bender 等人综述了早期的图像和音频数据隐藏技术 [38]，而 Kirovski 和 Malvar 则将扩频水印技术应用于音频信号 [39]。 WavMark 可在每秒钟的音频中编码多达 32 位，并在对 10-20 秒音频片段进行十次攻击后报告了 0.48% 的平均比特误码率 [40]。 AudioSeal 通过局部化损失函数训练生成器和检测器以实现样本级检测，并使用受听觉掩蔽启发的感知损失；其单次通过检测器专为大规模筛查而设计 [7]。 SilentCipher 增加了心理声学阈值处理和伪可微压缩层，并基于 44.1 kHz 的音频进行处理 [41]。 Perth 是一个开源库，其主要水印工具是一种神经隐式模型。 其文档声称该模型能够承受压缩和重采样，但目前尚无经过同行评审的评估结果 [42]。 WavMark 和 AudioSeal 的设计动机源于语音克隆，且主要基于语音数据进行评估；此外，这四种方法使用的原始采样率各不相同，因此必须通过统一协议固定重采样和编解码器设置，才能对它们的结果进行比较。

paragraphs.en: Classical perceptual hashes reduce an image to a short binary code that changes little under common processing. The average and difference hashes compare block means [ 43 , 44 ] ; pHash thresholds low-frequency DCT coefficients at their median [ 45 ] ; the Marr–Hildreth and block-mean hashes use edge and block statistics [ 45 , 46 ] , and implementations are collected in imagehash [ 47 ] , Blockhash [ 48 ] and OpenCV’s img_hash module [ 49 ] . Meta’s PDQ applies a DCT to a filtered 64 × \times 64 luminance image and keeps 256 bits together with a quality score [ 50 ] ; it is deployed in industry hash-sharing programmes. The ISCC Image-Code of ISO 24138 is a DCT hash of a 32 × \times 32 greyscale image after trimming uniform borders [ 15 ] . The ISCC benchmark TwinSpect [ 51 ] evaluates such compact codes, but to our knowledge no study has compared them with learned descriptors under a common false-positive calibration.
paragraphs.zh: 经典感知哈希将图像简化为一个短二进制代码，该代码在常见处理下变化很小。 平均哈希和差异哈希比较分块均值 [ 43 , 44 ]；pHash 以中位数为阈值对低频 DCT 系数进行判断 [ 45 ]；Marr–Hildreth 哈希和分块均值哈希则使用边缘和分块统计信息 [ 45 , 46 ]，相关实现已收录于 imagehash [ 47 ]、Blockhash [ 48 ] 以及 OpenCV 的 img_hash 模块中 [ 49 ]。 Meta 的 PDQ 方法对经过滤波的 64 × 64 亮度图像进行 DCT 变换，并保留 256 位哈希值及一个质量分数 [ 50 ]；该方法已应用于行业内的哈希共享计划中。 ISO 24138 标准中的 ISCC 图像代码是一种 DCT 哈希，其输入为经过均匀边界裁剪后的 32 × 32 灰度图像 [ 15 ]。 ISCC 基准测试 TwinSpect [ 51 ] 对这类紧凑编码进行了评估，但据我们所知，目前尚无研究在统一的误报率校准条件下将其与学习型描述符进行比较。

sents.zh: ISCC 基准测试 TwinSpect [ 51 ] 对这类紧凑编码进行了评估，但据我们所知，目前尚无研究在统一的误报率校准条件下将其与学习型描述符进行比较。

paragraphs.en: The Image Similarity Challenge 2021 and its DISC21 dataset established copy detection as a retrieval problem with a micro-average precision metric over one million references [ 12 ] . SSCD trains a descriptor with self-supervised contrastive learning, entropy regularisation and heavy augmentation, and outperformed classification-oriented self-supervised features by a wide margin [ 52 ] ; the winning descriptor-track entry used a large memory bank and negative-embedding subtraction [ 53 ] . General-purpose embeddings such as DINOv2 [ 54 ] and CLIP [ 55 , 56 ] capture semantics rather than copy identity, which helps under heavy geometric change but risks matching different photographs of the same object. ISCC’s experimental semantic image code binarises a descriptor derived from the ISC21 winner [ 57 ] , and DINOHash adversarially fine-tunes DINOv2 into a 96-bit hash [ 58 ] . Local features with geometric verification, from SIFT [ 59 ] and ORB [ 60 ] with RANSAC [ 61 ] to DISK [ 62 ] with LightGlue [ 63 ] , remain the standard way to confirm a partial copy and to register a query onto its source.
paragraphs.zh: 2021年图像相似性挑战及其DISC21数据集将复制检测确立为一个检索问题，采用百万级参考图像的微平均精度指标进行评估 [ 12 ] 。 SSCD通过自监督对比学习、熵正则化和强数据增强训练描述符，在性能上大幅优于以分类为导向的自监督特征 [ 52 ] ；获胜的描述符-跟踪条目使用了大型内存库和负嵌入减法技术 [ 53 ] 。 DINOv2 [ 54 ] 和CLIP [ 55 , 56 ] 等通用嵌入模型捕捉的是语义而非复制身份，这有助于应对严重的几何变化，但也存在将同一物体的不同照片误判为匹配的风险。 ISCC的实验性语义图像编码方法对源自ISC21冠军模型的描述符进行了二值化 [ 57 ] ，而DINOHash则通过对抗性微调将DINOv2转化为一个96位哈希值 [ 58 ] 。 从结合RANSAC [ 61 ] 的SIFT [ 59 ] 和ORB [ 60 ] ，到结合LightGlue [ 63 ] 的DISK [ 62 ] ，具有几何验证能力的局部特征仍然是确认部分复制并将查询图像与其源图像配准的标准方法。

paragraphs.en: For video, the MPEG-7 video signature [ 64 ] underlies the ISCC Video-Code, Meta’s TMK+PDQF pools per-frame PDQ features with a temporal match kernel [ 65 , 50 ] , and vPDQ matches clips by the share of frames with a close PDQ hash [ 66 ] . The 2023 Video Similarity Challenge showed that frame-level learned descriptors with temporal alignment dominate for copied segments [ 67 ] . Audio identification is mature: landmark hashing [ 68 ] and sub-band energy fingerprints [ 69 ] underlie tools such as audfprint [ 70 ] , Olaf [ 71 ] , Panako [ 72 ] and Chromaprint [ 73 ] , on which the ISCC Audio-Code is built. Neural audio fingerprints learn segment embeddings with contrastive objectives [ 74 , 75 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 对于视频，MPEG-7 视频签名 [64] 是 ISCC Video-Code 的基础；Meta 的 TMK+PDQ 池为每一帧提取 PDQ 特征，并结合时间匹配核 [65, 50]；而 vPDQ 则通过具有相近 PDQ 哈希值的帧的比例来匹配视频片段 [66]。 2023 年视频相似性挑战赛表明，对于复制片段而言，结合时间对齐的帧级学习描述符表现最为突出 [67]。 音频识别技术已相当成熟：地标哈希 [68] 和子带能量指纹 [69] 是 audfprint [70]、Olaf [71]、Panako [72] 和 Chromaprint [73] 等工具的基础，而 ISCC Audio-Code 正是基于这些工具构建的。 神经音频指纹技术通过对比学习目标来学习片段嵌入 [74, 75]。

paragraphs.en: Petitcolas et al. catalogued attacks on early copyright marking systems and argued that such systems need common evaluation [ 76 ] . Recent benchmarks were motivated by generative models. WAVES evaluates image watermarks on detection and identification under conventional distortions, regeneration by diffusion models and adversarial attacks [ 8 ] . W-Bench tests eleven image watermarking methods against regeneration, global and local editing and image-to-video generation, and proposes VINE, a watermark built on a pretrained diffusion model [ 9 ] . MarkDiffusion is a toolkit for in-generation watermarking of latent diffusion models, with shared evaluation pipelines for detectability, robustness and output quality [ 77 ] . AudioMarkBench evaluates three audio watermarking methods against 15 perturbations on a multilingual speech dataset under no-box, black-box and white-box threat models [ 10 ] . VideoMarkBench evaluates four video watermarking methods against 12 perturbations on clips produced by three video generators [ 11 ] .
paragraphs.zh: Petitcolas 等人对早期版权标记系统的攻击进行了分类，并指出此类系统需要共同的评估方法 [ 76 ] 。 近期的基准测试受到生成式模型的启发。 WAVES 在常规失真、扩散模型再生和对抗性攻击条件下，对图像水印的检测与识别能力进行了评估 [ 8 ] 。 W-Bench 将十一种图像水印方法置于再生、全局与局部编辑以及图像到视频生成等场景下进行了测试，并提出了基于预训练扩散模型的 VINE 水印方案 [ 9 ] 。 MarkDiffusion 是一个用于潜在扩散模型生成过程中嵌入水印的工具包，提供了可检测性、鲁棒性和输出质量的共享评估流程 [ 77 ] 。 AudioMarkBench 在无盒、黑盒和白盒威胁模型下，基于多语言语音数据集，对三种音频水印方法在 15 种扰动条件下的表现进行了评估 [ 10 ] 。 VideoMarkBench 在由三种视频生成器生成的视频片段上，对四种视频水印方法在 12 种扰动条件下的表现进行了评估 [ 11 ] 。

sents.zh: VideoMarkBench 在由三种视频生成器生成的视频片段上，对四种视频水印方法在 12 种扰动条件下的表现进行了评估 [ 11 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Attack papers bound what any benchmark can claim. Zhao et al. proved that regeneration attacks, which add noise and then reconstruct the image, remove pixel-level invisible watermarks [ 78 ] . Jiang et al. showed that small adversarial perturbations evade watermark detection with less visible change than JPEG compression or blurring [ 79 ] . Our watermarking track measures robustness to routine processing (codecs, resizing, cropping, filtering and resampling), that is, survival of ordinary distribution rather than security against a motivated adversary; the fingerprinting track adds white-box, transfer, forgery and inversion attacks (Section 5.6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 攻击论文挑战了任何基准测试所能声称的极限。 Zhao 等人证明了再生攻击——即先添加噪声再重建图像——能够移除像素级的隐形水印 [78]。 Jiang 等人指出，微小的对抗性扰动能够规避水印检测，且其可见变化比 JPEG 压缩或模糊更小 [79]。 我们的水印研究路线衡量的是对常规处理（编解码器、调整大小、裁剪、滤波和重采样）的鲁棒性，也就是说，水印在普通传播过程中的存活能力，而非针对有恶意意图的对手的安全性；指纹识别研究路线则增加了白盒攻击、迁移攻击、伪造攻击和逆推攻击（第 5.6 节）。

sents.en: Attack papers bound what any benchmark can claim.
sents.zh: 攻击论文挑战了任何基准测试所能声称的极限。

sents.en: Zhao et al. proved that regeneration attacks, which add noise and then reconstruct the image, remove pixel-level invisible watermarks [ 78 ] .
sents.zh: Zhao 等人证明了再生攻击——即先添加噪声再重建图像——能够移除像素级的隐形水印 [78]。

sents.zh: 我们的水印研究路线衡量的是对常规处理（编解码器、调整大小、裁剪、滤波和重采样）的鲁棒性，也就是说，水印在普通传播过程中的存活能力，而非针对有恶意意图的对手的安全性；指纹识别研究路线则增加了白盒攻击、迁移攻击、伪造攻击和逆推攻击（第 5.6 节）。

paragraphs.en: Perceptual hashes were designed for benign processing, not for an adversary. Gradient attacks against Apple’s NeuralHash produced collisions and evasions with imperceptible perturbations [ 80 ] ; black-box attacks evaded PDQ and PhotoDNA and forged targeted collisions [ 13 , 14 , 81 ] ; and inversion attacks reconstruct recognisable images from PDQ, PhotoDNA and NeuralHash codes [ 82 , 83 ] . The last result matters for provenance: a soft-binding value is written into the manifest, so a descriptor that can be inverted discloses content to anyone who reads the manifest.
paragraphs.zh: 感知哈希最初是为良性处理而设计的，而非用于对抗攻击者。 针对 Apple NeuralHash 的梯度攻击产生了通过不可察觉扰动实现的碰撞和规避 [80]；黑盒攻击则规避了 PDQ 和 PhotoDNA，并制造了目标碰撞 [13, 14, 81]；而逆推攻击则能从 PDQ、PhotoDNA 和 NeuralHash 码中重建出可识别的图像 [82, 83]。 最后一个结果对来源验证至关重要：一个软绑定值会被写入清单，因此任何能够被逆推的描述符都会向阅读清单的人暴露内容。

sents.en: Perceptual hashes were designed for benign processing, not for an adversary.
sents.zh: 感知哈希最初是为良性处理而设计的，而非用于对抗攻击者。

paragraphs.en: Following standard practice for binomial rates and resampled statistics, we report exact Clopper-Pearson intervals [ 84 ] and bootstrap intervals [ 85 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 遵循二项率与重采样统计的标准做法，我们报告了精确的Clopper-Pearson置信区间[ 84 ]和自助法置信区间[ 85 ]。

paragraphs.en: Invisible watermarks [ 4 , 7 , 35 ] carry a key that points to the manifest directly, while a fingerprint needs a registry lookup but survives when the watermark is removed or was never embedded. Watermarks that localize edits [ 86 , 87 ] and blind forensic detectors [ 88 ] address tampering without a reference. Prior benchmarks evaluate each family on its own; we measure their interaction on the same media and attacks.
paragraphs.zh: 不可见水印 [ 4 , 7 , 35 ] 携带一个直接指向清单的密钥，而指纹则需要通过注册表查询，但在水印被移除或从未嵌入时仍能保留。 能够定位编辑操作的水印 [ 86 , 87 ] 和能欺骗数字取证检测器的水印 [ 88 ]，可在没有参考文件的情况下应对篡改行为。 以往的基准测试分别评估每个水印家族；我们则测量它们在相同媒体和攻击场景下的相互作用。

paragraphs.en: Most watermarking papers report PSNR and SSIM [ 89 ] , and some add MS-SSIM [ 90 ] or the learned LPIPS distance [ 91 ] . These metrics summarize an average difference. Watermark residuals, however, are often structured patterns that a viewer notices in flat regions or when switching between the original and the marked image. FLIP models this second case: it estimates the differences an observer perceives when flipping between two images [ 92 ] . ColorVideoVDP models spatial and temporal vision for luminance and colour and accounts for viewing conditions and display characteristics [ 93 ] . VMAF is a perceptual video quality metric in common use for encoder tuning [ 94 ] . The Pixel Seal authors argue that proxy losses such as MSE and LPIPS fail to predict visible artefacts [ 6 ] , which is one reason to report display-aware metrics next to PSNR.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数水印相关论文都会报告 PSNR 和 SSIM [89]，有些还会补充 MS-SSIM [90] 或经过学习的 LPIPS 距离 [91]。 这些指标总结了平均差异。 然而，水印残留通常是有结构的模式，观众在平坦区域或在原始图像与带水印图像之间切换时能够注意到它们。 FLIP 模型模拟了后一种情况：它估算出观察者在两幅图像之间切换时所感知到的差异 [92]。 ColorVideoVDP 模型模拟了亮度与色彩的时空视觉特性，并考虑了观看条件和显示特性 [93]。 VMAF 是一种常用的感知视频质量指标，常用于编码器调优 [94]。 Pixel Seal 的作者认为，像 MSE 和 LPIPS 这类代理损失无法预测可见的伪影 [6]，这也是在报告 PSNR 的同时需要报告显示相关指标的原因之一。

paragraphs.en: For audio, SNR and scale-invariant SNR [ 95 ] measure waveform error. PESQ [ 96 , 97 ] and its wideband extension [ 98 ] predict speech quality. The ITU withdrew both recommendations in January 2024 in favour of P.863, but they are still used, which keeps results comparable with earlier watermarking papers. PESQ was designed for telephone speech and does not apply to music. STOI predicts intelligibility [ 99 ] . Integrated loudness under ITU-R BS.1770 [ 100 ] and EBU R 128 [ 101 ] detects level changes that waveform metrics do not isolate.
paragraphs.zh: 对于音频，信噪比（SNR）和尺度不变信噪比（scale-invariant SNR）[ 95 ]用于衡量波形误差。 PESQ [ 96 , 97 ]及其宽带扩展版本 [ 98 ]可预测语音质量。 ITU于2024年1月撤销了这两项建议，转而采用P.863，但它们仍在使用，这使得研究结果与早期的数字水印论文具有可比性。 PESQ是为电话语音设计的，不适用于音乐。 STOI可预测语音的可理解度 [ 99 ]。 根据ITU-R BS.1770 [ 100 ]和EBU R 128 [ 101 ]标准计算的集成响度能够检测出波形指标无法单独识别的音量变化。

sents.en: For audio, SNR and scale-invariant SNR [ 95 ] measure waveform error.
sents.zh: 对于音频，信噪比（SNR）和尺度不变信噪比（scale-invariant SNR）[ 95 ]用于衡量波形误差。

paragraphs.en: The benchmark has two tracks, one per family of soft binding, that share their principles, their hosts and, for the combination experiment, their media. This section states what they share and then describes each track’s protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 该基准测试包含两条赛道，每条赛道对应一种软结合类型，它们共享相同的原则、宿主，以及在组合实验中使用的介质。 本节首先说明它们的共同点，然后分别描述每条赛道的协议。

sents.en: The benchmark has two tracks, one per family of soft binding, that share their principles, their hosts and, for the combination experiment, their media.
sents.zh: 该基准测试包含两条赛道，每条赛道对应一种软结合类型，它们共享相同的原则、宿主，以及在组合实验中使用的介质。

sents.en: This section states what they share and then describes each track’s protocol.
sents.zh: 本节首先说明它们的共同点，然后分别描述每条赛道的协议。

paragraphs.en: A provenance service can deploy only models whose code and weights permit commercial use, and the two licences differ in several projects; the weights may also have been trained on data restricted to non-commercial use. We recorded all three for every method. Methods that fail the audit were measured as reference points and are marked † (watermarks) or † (fingerprints) in every table; they are excluded from rankings and recommendations.
paragraphs.zh: 来源追溯服务只能部署其代码和权重允许商业使用的模型，且这两种许可在多个项目中存在差异；这些权重也可能是在限制为非商业用途的数据上训练的。 我们对每种方法都记录了全部三种情况。 未通过审核的方法被用作参考点，并在每张表格中标记为 †（水印）或 †（指纹）；它们不会被纳入排名和推荐中。

sents.en: A provenance service can deploy only models whose code and weights permit commercial use, and the two licences differ in several projects; the weights may also have been trained on data restricted to non-commercial use.
sents.zh: 来源追溯服务只能部署其代码和权重允许商业使用的模型，且这两种许可在多个项目中存在差异；这些权重也可能是在限制为非商业用途的数据上训练的。

sents.en: We recorded all three for every method.
sents.zh: 我们对每种方法都记录了全部三种情况。

sents.en: Methods that fail the audit were measured as reference points and are marked † (watermarks) or † (fingerprints) in every table; they are excluded from rankings and recommendations.
sents.zh: 未通过审核的方法被用作参考点，并在每张表格中标记为 †（水印）或 †（指纹）；它们不会被纳入排名和推荐中。

paragraphs.en: All media are public and were fetched from their distribution points; every file is pinned by SHA-256 in a manifest. No private or personal media were used. All randomness (payloads, transformations, splits) is seeded, so every method sees byte-identical inputs.
paragraphs.zh: 所有媒体均为公共媒体，且均从其分发点获取；每个文件都通过 SHA-256 在清单中进行了固定。 未使用任何私有或个人媒体。 所有随机性（有效载荷、转换、分割）均有种子初始化，因此每种方法都能看到字节完全相同的输入。

sents.en: All media are public and were fetched from their distribution points; every file is pinned by SHA-256 in a manifest.
sents.zh: 所有媒体均为公共媒体，且均从其分发点获取；每个文件都通过 SHA-256 在清单中进行了固定。

sents.en: No private or personal media were used.
sents.zh: 未使用任何私有或个人媒体。

sents.en: All randomness (payloads, transformations, splits) is seeded, so every method sees byte-identical inputs.
sents.zh: 所有随机性（有效载荷、转换、分割）均有种子初始化，因此每种方法都能看到字节完全相同的输入。

paragraphs.en: A soft binding is useful only if it rarely points unmarked or unregistered content at someone else’s manifest. Both tracks therefore fix the decision rule before measuring robustness. For watermarks, the rule is either the model’s blind detector or an expected-payload test that requires k k of n n decoded bits to match the key the verifier expects, with k k chosen for a per-key false-match probability of at most 10 − 6 10^{-6} under independent fair bits. For fingerprints, thresholds are fixed on one half of the never-registered negatives, at query-level and at registry-size-independent pair-level false-match rates, and evaluated on the other half; a target is reported only if the calibration set resolves it. Detection is always reported at such an operating point, next to threshold-free measures.
paragraphs.zh: 软绑定只有在很少将未标记或未注册的内容指向他人清单时才有用。 因此，这两种方法在衡量鲁棒性之前都先确定了决策规则。 对于水印，该规则要么是模型的盲检测器，要么是一种预期负载测试，要求 n 个已解码的比特中至少有 k 个与验证者预期的密钥匹配，其中 k 的选择使得在独立公平比特条件下，每个密钥的误匹配概率最多为 10⁻⁶。 对于指纹，阈值固定在一半从未注册过的负样本上，分别基于查询级别的误匹配率和与注册表大小无关的对级别误匹配率，并在另一半样本上进行评估；只有当校准集能够确定目标时，才会报告该目标。 检测总是在这样的操作点上报告，并附带无需阈值的指标。

sents.zh: 软绑定只有在很少将未标记或未注册的内容指向他人清单时才有用。

sents.en: Both tracks therefore fix the decision rule before measuring robustness.
sents.zh: 因此，这两种方法在衡量鲁棒性之前都先确定了决策规则。

sents.en: For watermarks, the rule is either the model’s blind detector or an expected-payload test that requires k k of n n decoded bits to match the key the verifier expects, with k k chosen for a per-key false-match probability of at most 10 − 6 10^{-6} under independent fair bits.

sents.zh: 对于指纹，阈值固定在一半从未注册过的负样本上，分别基于查询级别的误匹配率和与注册表大小无关的对级别误匹配率，并在另一半样本上进行评估；只有当校准集能够确定目标时，才会报告该目标。

sents.en: Detection is always reported at such an operating point, next to threshold-free measures.
sents.zh: 检测总是在这样的操作点上报告，并附带无需阈值的指标。

paragraphs.en: Every image, clip or track contributes one query per transformation, and the transformed copies of one source succeed or fail together far more often than independent queries would. Intervals therefore come from bootstraps over sources (for fingerprint retrieval rates and paired differences, with the threshold recomputed from the resampled calibration set in every replicate), exact intervals for watermark false positives count sources rather than trials, and paired comparisons pair by source. For audio watermarks, whose clips were rendered at three sample rates, the clip is the source.
paragraphs.zh: 每张图像、每个片段或每条音轨在每次转换中都会贡献一次查询，而同一源内容的转换副本成功或失败的情况，远比独立查询的情况更为频繁。 因此，区间来源于对源内容的自启动（用于指纹检索率和配对差异，其中阈值在每次重复实验中均根据重采样的校准集重新计算）；水印误报的精确区间按源内容计数而非试验次数，而配对比较则按源内容进行配对。 对于音频水印，其片段是以三种采样率渲染的，因此片段即为源内容。

sents.en: Every image, clip or track contributes one query per transformation, and the transformed copies of one source succeed or fail together far more often than independent queries would.
sents.zh: 每张图像、每个片段或每条音轨在每次转换中都会贡献一次查询，而同一源内容的转换副本成功或失败的情况，远比独立查询的情况更为频繁。

sents.en: For audio watermarks, whose clips were rendered at three sample rates, the clip is the source.
sents.zh: 对于音频水印，其片段是以三种采样率渲染的，因此片段即为源内容。

paragraphs.en: GPU work ran on NVIDIA A10G instances (AWS g5, AMD EPYC 7R32) and CPU work on the same processor family; latency is reported per network on an idle host. Because the watermarking track found host-dependent decoder outputs, both tracks were also run or decoded on an Apple M5 Pro (arm64) laptop to test determinism.
paragraphs.zh: GPU 任务在 NVIDIA A10G 实例（AWS g5、AMD EPYC 7R32）上运行，CPU 任务则在同一处理器系列上运行；延迟数据是在空闲主机上按网络报告的。 由于水印轨道发现了与主机相关的解码器输出，因此两个轨道均在 Apple M5 Pro（arm64）笔记本电脑上运行或解码，以测试确定性。

sents.en: Because the watermarking track found host-dependent decoder outputs, both tracks were also run or decoded on an Apple M5 Pro (arm64) laptop to test determinism.

paragraphs.en: Fig. 1 summarises the protocol. Each configuration embeds a pseudo-random payload into every corpus item, the marked item is measured against the original, a fixed set of transformations is applied, and the decoder output is compared with the embedded payload. Unmarked items pass through the same decoders to measure false positives. All randomness is seeded, and payloads are derived from a hash of a fixed seed and the item index, so every configuration of a given payload size receives the same message for the same item.
paragraphs.zh: 图 1 总结了该协议。 每种配置都将一个伪随机有效载荷嵌入到每个语料库项中，标记项会与原始项进行比较，应用一组固定的变换，然后将解码器输出与嵌入的有效载荷进行比较。 未标记项会经过相同的解码器，以测量误报。 所有随机性都通过种子初始化，有效载荷由固定种子和项索引的哈希值生成，因此对于给定的有效载荷大小，每种配置在相同项上都会接收到相同的信息。

sents.en: Fig. 1 summarises the protocol.
sents.zh: 图 1 总结了该协议。

sents.en: Each configuration embeds a pseudo-random payload into every corpus item, the marked item is measured against the original, a fixed set of transformations is applied, and the decoder output is compared with the embedded payload.

sents.en: All randomness is seeded, and payloads are derived from a hash of a fixed seed and the item index, so every configuration of a given payload size receives the same message for the same item.
sents.zh: 所有随机性都通过种子初始化，有效载荷由固定种子和项索引的哈希值生成，因此对于给定的有效载荷大小，每种配置在相同项上都会接收到相同的信息。

paragraphs.en: We selected watermarking methods that are distributed with trained weights and an inference implementation, and that target natural images, speech and music, or natural video. Table 1 lists them. For each method we recorded the licence of the code and, separately, of the weights, because the two differ in several projects. A configuration counts as open only when both carry a licence that permits commercial use. Methods whose weights have no stated licence, or whose weight provenance we could not establish, were still measured and are reported as reference points, but they are excluded from every ranking. Several methods were excluded before measurement: VINE, whose code licence is non-commercial [ 9 ] ; the WAM checkpoint trained on COCO, licensed CC BY-NC [ 30 ] ; and DVMark, for which no weights are released [ 34 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 我们选择了那些随训练权重和推理实现一同分发，并且针对自然图像、语音和音乐或自然视频的水印方法。表 1 列出了这些方法。 对于每种方法，我们都记录了代码的许可协议以及权重的许可协议（二者在某些项目中有所不同）。 只有当代码和权重都采用允许商业使用的许可协议时，该配置才被视为开源。 对于那些权重未声明许可协议或无法确定其来源的方法，我们仍然进行了测试，并将其作为参考点报告，但它们在所有排名中均被排除在外。 在测试前，有几种方法已被排除：VINE（其代码许可为非商业性 [9]）；在 COCO 上训练的 WAM 检查点（许可协议为 CC BY-NC [30]）；以及 DVMark（未发布任何权重 [34]）。

sents.zh: 对于每种方法，我们都记录了代码的许可协议以及权重的许可协议（二者在某些项目中有所不同）。

sents.zh: 只有当代码和权重都采用允许商业使用的许可协议时，该配置才被视为开源。

sents.en: Methods whose weights have no stated licence, or whose weight provenance we could not establish, were still measured and are reported as reference points, but they are excluded from every ranking.
sents.zh: 对于那些权重未声明许可协议或无法确定其来源的方法，我们仍然进行了测试，并将其作为参考点报告，但它们在所有排名中均被排除在外。

sents.en: Several methods were excluded before measurement: VINE, whose code licence is non-commercial [ 9 ] ; the WAM checkpoint trained on COCO, licensed CC BY-NC [ 30 ] ; and DVMark, for which no weights are released [ 34 ] .
sents.zh: 在测试前，有几种方法已被排除：VINE（其代码许可为非商业性 [9]）；在 COCO 上训练的 WAM 检查点（许可协议为 CC BY-NC [30]）；以及 DVMark（未发布任何权重 [34]）。

paragraphs.en: Strength was varied where a method exposes a single scalar that scales the embedded residual: the TrustMark strength factor, the blending factor of the PixelSeal, Video Seal and WAM embedders, and the AudioSeal output scale. We kept each method’s default and added settings on both sides of it. For PixelSeal we added two settings between 0.1 and the default 0.2 after an initial pass showed that the robustness threshold is crossed in that interval. All other hyperparameters were left at the values published with the weights.
paragraphs.zh: 在某个方法仅暴露一个标量来缩放嵌入残差时，其强度会发生变化：即 TrustMark 强度因子、PixelSeal、Video Seal 和 WAM 嵌入器的混合因子，以及 AudioSeal 的输出缩放因子。 我们保留了每种方法的默认设置，并在其两侧添加了额外设置。 对于 PixelSeal，我们在初始测试表明鲁棒性阈值在该区间内被跨越后，在 0.1 和默认值 0.2 之间添加了两个设置。 所有其他超参数均保持为随权重一同发布的数值。

sents.zh: 所有其他超参数均保持为随权重一同发布的数值。

paragraphs.en: Bits: payload bits carried and compared. TrustMark transmits a 100-bit codeword; in the BCH_5 mode used here it carries a 61-bit payload, 35 BCH parity bits and 4 version bits. Bit accuracy and the expected-payload test use the 100 transmitted bits; exact recovery compares the 61 decoded payload bits. a The MIT-licensed checkpoint trained on SA-1B; the checkpoint trained on COCO is licensed CC BY-NC and was not used. † Reported for reference only. Perth signals presence without a payload. Every checkpoint is pinned by SHA-256 in the lockfile kept with the scripts (Data and Code Availability).
paragraphs.zh: 比特：所携带并比较的有效载荷比特。 TrustMark 传输一个 100 比特的码字；在此使用的 BCH_5 模式下，它包含 61 比特有效载荷、35 个 BCH 奇偶校验比特和 4 个版本比特。 比特准确度和预期有效载荷测试使用这 100 个已传输的比特；精确恢复则对 61 个解码后的有效载荷比特进行比较。a 基于 SA-1B 训练的 MIT 许可检查点；基于 COCO 训练的检查点采用 CC BY-NC 许可，且未被使用。† 仅作为参考报告。 Perth 在没有有效载荷的情况下表示存在。 每个检查点都通过 SHA-256 在脚本中保留的锁文件中进行了固定（数据与代码可用性）。

paragraphs.en: Images (85 items): the 24 Kodak images [ 102 ] , 25 DIV2K validation images [ 103 ] at about 2K resolution, 28 CLIC 2020 professional validation images [ 104 ] , and 8 CC0 high-dynamic-range panoramas from Poly Haven [ 105 ] , exposure-normalised to a median luminance of 0.18 and stored as 16-bit sRGB TIFF. DIV2K images are used for measurement only and are not redistributed. FLIP was computed on the 60 Kodak, CLIC and HDR images and ColorVideoVDP on the 32 Kodak and HDR images, because both are costly at DIV2K resolution; the other metrics use all 85 images.
paragraphs.zh: 图像（85 项）：24 张 Kodak 图像 [ 102 ]、约 2K 分辨率的 25 张 DIV2K 验证图像 [ 103 ]、28 张 CLIC 2020 专业验证图像 [ 104 ]，以及来自 Poly Haven 的 8 张 CC0 高动态范围全景图 [ 105 ]；这些图像已将曝光归一化为 0.18 的中值亮度，并以 16 位 sRGB TIFF 格式存储。 DIV2K 图像仅用于测量，不会重新分发。 FLIP 是在 60 张 Kodak、CLIC 和 HDR 图像上计算的，而 ColorVideoVDP 则是在 32 张 Kodak 和 HDR 图像上计算的，因为这两种指标在 DIV2K 分辨率下计算成本较高；其他指标则使用了全部 85 张图像。

sents.zh: 图像（85 项）：24 张 Kodak 图像 [ 102 ]、约 2K 分辨率的 25 张 DIV2K 验证图像 [ 103 ]、28 张 CLIC 2020 专业验证图像 [ 104 ]，以及来自 Poly Haven 的 8 张 CC0 高动态范围全景图 [ 105 ]；这些图像已将曝光归一化为 0.18 的中值亮度，并以 16 位 sRGB TIFF 格式存储。

sents.zh: DIV2K 图像仅用于测量，不会重新分发。

sents.en: FLIP was computed on the 60 Kodak, CLIC and HDR images and ColorVideoVDP on the 32 Kodak and HDR images, because both are costly at DIV2K resolution; the other metrics use all 85 images.
sents.zh: FLIP 是在 60 张 Kodak、CLIC 和 HDR 图像上计算的，而 ColorVideoVDP 则是在 32 张 Kodak 和 HDR 图像上计算的，因为这两种指标在 DIV2K 分辨率下计算成本较高；其他指标则使用了全部 85 张图像。

paragraphs.en: Audio (138 inputs from 46 source clips): 40 LibriSpeech test-clean utterances from 40 different speakers [ 106 ] and 7 public-domain or CC BY music excerpts distributed with librosa [ 107 ] , each resampled to 16, 44.1 and 48 kHz. One music excerpt failed in every configuration at all three rates; we treat a clip that fails for every method as a corpus defect and exclude it everywhere, leaving 46 source clips (40 speech, 6 music) and 138 inputs, of which 120 are speech and 18 music. The three renderings of a clip are not independent samples; Section 3.2.9 explains how the statistics account for this.
paragraphs.zh: 音频（来自 46 个源剪辑的 138 个输入）：40 位不同说话者的 40 条 LibriSpeech test-clean 语段 [106]，以及随 librosa 分发的 7 段公共领域或 CC BY 许可的音乐片段 [107]，每种音频均重采样至 16、44.1 和 48 kHz。 在所有配置中，每三种采样率下都有一个音乐片段失败；我们将所有方法都失败的剪辑视为语料缺陷并处处排除，最终保留 46 个源剪辑（40 个语音，6 个音乐）和 138 个输入，其中 120 个为语音，18 个为音乐。 一个剪辑的三种渲染结果并非独立的样本；第 3.2.9 节说明了统计方法如何对此进行考量。

sents.en: Audio (138 inputs from 46 source clips): 40 LibriSpeech test-clean utterances from 40 different speakers [ 106 ] and 7 public-domain or CC BY music excerpts distributed with librosa [ 107 ] , each resampled to 16, 44.1 and 48 kHz.
sents.zh: 音频（来自 46 个源剪辑的 138 个输入）：40 位不同说话者的 40 条 LibriSpeech test-clean 语段 [106]，以及随 librosa 分发的 7 段公共领域或 CC BY 许可的音乐片段 [107]，每种音频均重采样至 16、44.1 和 48 kHz。

sents.zh: 在所有配置中，每三种采样率下都有一个音乐片段失败；我们将所有方法都失败的剪辑视为语料缺陷并处处排除，最终保留 46 个源剪辑（40 个语音，6 个音乐）和 138 个输入，其中 120 个为语音，18 个为音乐。

sents.en: The three renderings of a clip are not independent samples; Section 3.2.9 explains how the statistics account for this.
sents.zh: 一个剪辑的三种渲染结果并非独立的样本；第 3.2.9 节说明了统计方法如何对此进行考量。

paragraphs.en: Video (6 clips): the first 2.5 s of six 1080p sequences from the Xiph test-media collection [ 108 ] ( aspen , controlled burn , red kayak , speed bag , crowd run and the Sintel trailer), covering slow and fast motion, fine texture and synthetic content.
paragraphs.zh: 视频（6个片段）：来自 Xiph 测试媒体集 [108] 的六个 1080p 序列的前 2.5 秒（包括 aspen、controlled burn、red kayak、speed bag、crowd run 和 Sintel 预告片），涵盖了慢动作与快动作、精细纹理以及合成内容。

paragraphs.en: Image transformations (14): JPEG at quality 90, 75, 60 and 50; WebP at 80 and 60; bicubic downscaling to 0.75 and 0.5; centre crops retaining 90, 70 and 50% of each side; Gaussian blur with σ = 1 \sigma=1 ; and brightness scaling by 0.8 and 1.2. Audio transformations (10): MP3 at 320, 128 and 64 kb/s; AAC at 256, 128 and 64 kb/s; resampling round trips through 22.05 and 8 kHz; gain of − 6 -6 dB; and additive white noise at 30 dB SNR. Codec round trips are aligned to the original by cross-correlation before decoding, so that encoder delay does not register as watermark loss. A verifier that holds only the received file cannot do this, so a follow-up experiment decoded the same round trips without alignment (Section 4.2 ). Video transformations (8): H.264 at CRF 18, 22, 23 and 28; H.265 at CRF 23 and 28; and H.264 at CRF 23 after 0.5 downscaling or a 75% centre crop. Marked video is stored losslessly (FFV1, 4:4:4) before each transformation, so the transformation is the only lossy step.
paragraphs.zh: 图像变换（14 种）：JPEG 质量设为 90、75、60 和 50；WebP 质量设为 80 和 60；双三次插值下采样至 0.75 和 0.5；中心裁剪保留每边 90%、70% 和 50% 的内容；高斯模糊，σ = 1 \sigma=1；亮度缩放系数为 0.8 和 1.2。 音频变换（10 种）：MP3 比特率设为 320、128 和 64 kb/s；AAC 比特率设为 256、128 和 64 kb/s；通过 22.05 kHz 和 8 kHz 进行重采样往返处理；增益为 −6 -6 dB；以及添加信噪比（SNR）为 30 dB 的白色噪声。 编解码器往返处理在解码前通过互相关与原始数据对齐，因此编码器延迟不会被视为水印损失。 仅持有接收文件的验证器无法执行此操作，因此后续实验在未对齐的情况下对相同的往返处理进行了解码（第 4.2 节）。 视频变换（8 种）：H.264 的 CRF 设为 18、22、23 和 28；H.265 的 CRF 设为 23 和 28；以及 H.264 在 0.5 倍下采样或 75% 中心裁剪后的 CRF 28。 标记视频在每次变换前均以无损方式存储（FFV1，4:4:4），因此变换是唯一有损的步骤。

sents.en: Image transformations (14): JPEG at quality 90, 75, 60 and 50; WebP at 80 and 60; bicubic downscaling to 0.75 and 0.5; centre crops retaining 90, 70 and 50% of each side; Gaussian blur with σ = 1 \sigma=1 ; and brightness scaling by 0.8 and 1.2.
sents.zh: 图像变换（14 种）：JPEG 质量设为 90、75、60 和 50；WebP 质量设为 80 和 60；双三次插值下采样至 0.75 和 0.5；中心裁剪保留每边 90%、70% 和 50% 的内容；高斯模糊，σ = 1 \sigma=1；亮度缩放系数为 0.8 和 1.2。

sents.en: Audio transformations (10): MP3 at 320, 128 and 64 kb/s; AAC at 256, 128 and 64 kb/s; resampling round trips through 22.05 and 8 kHz; gain of − 6 -6 dB; and additive white noise at 30 dB SNR.
sents.zh: 音频变换（10 种）：MP3 比特率设为 320、128 和 64 kb/s；AAC 比特率设为 256、128 和 64 kb/s；通过 22.05 kHz 和 8 kHz 进行重采样往返处理；增益为 −6 -6 dB；以及添加信噪比（SNR）为 30 dB 的白色噪声。

sents.en: Codec round trips are aligned to the original by cross-correlation before decoding, so that encoder delay does not register as watermark loss.
sents.zh: 编解码器往返处理在解码前通过互相关与原始数据对齐，因此编码器延迟不会被视为水印损失。

sents.en: A verifier that holds only the received file cannot do this, so a follow-up experiment decoded the same round trips without alignment (Section 4.2 ).
sents.zh: 仅持有接收文件的验证器无法执行此操作，因此后续实验在未对齐的情况下对相同的往返处理进行了解码（第 4.2 节）。

sents.en: Video transformations (8): H.264 at CRF 18, 22, 23 and 28; H.265 at CRF 23 and 28; and H.264 at CRF 23 after 0.5 downscaling or a 75% centre crop.
sents.zh: 视频变换（8 种）：H.264 的 CRF 设为 18、22、23 和 28；H.265 的 CRF 设为 23 和 28；以及 H.264 在 0.5 倍下采样或 75% 中心裁剪后的 CRF 28。

sents.en: Marked video is stored losslessly (FFV1, 4:4:4) before each transformation, so the transformation is the only lossy step.
sents.zh: 标记视频在每次变换前均以无损方式存储（FFV1，4:4:4），因此变换是唯一有损的步骤。

paragraphs.en: One transformation per modality serves as the gate : JPEG 75 for images, MP3 at 128 kb/s for audio and H.264 at CRF 23 for video. These are common default settings in sharing pipelines, and a watermark that does not survive them is of little use for provenance.
paragraphs.zh: 每种模态进行一次转换作为门控：图像使用 JPEG 75，音频使用 MP3 128 kb/s，视频使用 H.264 CRF 23。 这些是共享流程中的常见默认设置，无法在这些处理中保留的水印对于来源追溯几乎毫无用处。

sents.en: One transformation per modality serves as the gate : JPEG 75 for images, MP3 at 128 kb/s for audio and H.264 at CRF 23 for video.
sents.zh: 每种模态进行一次转换作为门控：图像使用 JPEG 75，音频使用 MP3 128 kb/s，视频使用 H.264 CRF 23。

sents.en: These are common default settings in sharing pipelines, and a watermark that does not survive them is of little use for provenance.
sents.zh: 这些是共享流程中的常见默认设置，无法在这些处理中保留的水印对于来源追溯几乎毫无用处。

paragraphs.en: Image quality was measured with PSNR, SSIM [ 89 ] , MS-SSIM [ 90 ] , LPIPS [ 91 ] , FLIP [ 92 ] and ColorVideoVDP [ 93 ] . We use FLIP as the primary image metric because it models the visibility of differences when flipping between two images, which is the viewing condition under which an embedded pattern is most likely to be noticed. Audio quality was measured with SNR, SI-SNR [ 95 ] , wideband PESQ [ 98 ] , STOI [ 99 ] , the absolute change in integrated loudness following ITU-R BS.1770 [ 100 ] , and a log-spectral difference. PESQ is primary. It was designed and validated for speech, so the primary PESQ value is the mean over the 120 speech inputs only; PESQ on the 18 music inputs is reported separately and not used for ranking. Video quality was measured with PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS and FLIP averaged over frames, and with VMAF [ 94 ] , which is primary.
paragraphs.zh: 图像质量通过 PSNR、SSIM [ 89 ]、MS-SSIM [ 90 ]、LPIPS [ 91 ]、FLIP [ 92 ] 和 ColorVideoVDP [ 93 ] 进行测量。 我们将 FLIP 作为主要图像质量指标，因为它能够模拟在两张图像之间翻转时差异的可见性，而这种观看条件最有可能让人注意到嵌入的模式。 音频质量通过 SNR、SI-SNR [ 95 ]、宽带 PESQ [ 98 ]、STOI [ 99 ]、遵循 ITU-R BS.1770 标准的集成响度绝对变化量以及对数频谱差异进行测量。PESQ 是主要指标。 该指标是为语音设计的并经过验证，因此主要 PESQ 值仅基于 120 个语音输入的均值；18 个音乐输入的 PESQ 值则单独报告，不用于排名。 视频质量通过各帧的平均 PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS 和 FLIP 进行测量，同时也使用 VMAF [ 94 ]，后者是主要指标。

paragraphs.en: Robustness is the fraction of payload bits recovered correctly after a transformation (bit accuracy), averaged over items. Because a verifier acts on a decision rather than on a bit rate, we also report two payload-level rates (Table 4 ): exact recovery , the share of items whose decoded payload equals the embedded one, after BCH decoding of its 61-bit payload for TrustMark (the only method with an error-correcting layer) and with every bit correct for the others; and the share of items that pass the expected-payload test of Section 3.2.6 ( ≥ k \geq k of n n bits). For video, decoder logits are averaged over all frames of a clip before thresholding, which is the aggregation the Video Seal and PixelSeal decoders are designed for. We report the pooled mean and the mean on the worst content subset (image corpus, audio source and sample rate, or video clip), because a pooled mean can hide systematic failure on one kind of content.
paragraphs.zh: 鲁棒性是指在变换后正确恢复的有效载荷比特所占的比例（比特准确率），并对所有项目取平均值。 由于验证器作用于决策而非比特率，我们还报告了两种有效载荷级别的比率（表4）：精确恢复，即经过 TrustMark 的 61 比特有效载荷的 BCH 解码后，其解码出的有效载荷与嵌入的有效载荷相等的项目比例（TrustMark 是唯一具有纠错层的方案），而其他方案则要求所有比特均正确；以及通过第 3.2.6 节中预期有效载荷测试的项目比例（n 个比特中至少有 k 个比特正确）。 对于视频，在应用阈值之前，需对解码器 logits 在所有帧上进行平均，这正是 Video Seal 和 PixelSeal 解码器的设计所要求的聚合方式。 我们报告了合并均值以及在最劣内容子集（图像语料库、音频源和采样率，或视频片段）上的均值，因为合并均值可能会掩盖某类内容上的系统性故障。

paragraphs.en: False-positive trials run each decoder on the unmarked corpus under no transformation and three benign ones (JPEG 75, 0.5 downscale and 70% crop for images; the untouched signal, MP3 at 128 kb/s and a 22.05 kHz round trip for audio; and, for video, the H.264 CRF 18 encode of each unmarked clip). A verifier checks one fixed expected payload, the one recorded for the asset; comparing each decode with the item’s own payload is that check. We also compare each decode with 50 unrelated payloads (200 for video), one fixed list shared by all items. These comparisons test whether decoded bits agree with payloads the content was never marked with, conditional on the decodes we have; they reuse the same decodes and therefore add no independent media, and we report them as counts and as the largest number of matching bits observed, not as additional trials. The transformed copies of one item, and the three renderings of one audio clip, share their source, so observed rates and their exact Clopper-Pearson intervals [ 84 ] use the unmarked source as the trial unit: 85 images, 46 audio clips and 6 video clips. All intervals are two-sided at 95%. We also plot the distribution of matching bits against the binomial null.
paragraphs.zh: 假阳性试验中，每个解码器都在未标记语料库上运行，且无任何转换操作，同时运行三种良性转换（图像采用 JPEG 75、0.5 倍下采样和 70% 裁剪；音频使用原始信号、MP3 128 kb/s 和 22.05 kHz 往返处理；视频则对每个未标记片段进行 H.264 CRF 18 编码）。 验证器会检查一个固定的预期有效载荷，即该资源记录下来的有效载荷；将每次解码结果与该资源自身的实际有效载荷进行比较，即为这一检查过程。 我们还将每次解码结果与 50 个无关的有效载荷（视频为 200 个）进行比较，这些载荷来自一个所有资源共享的固定列表。 这些比较旨在检验：在已有解码结果的前提下，解码出的比特是否与内容从未被标记为对应类型的那些有效载荷一致；由于重复使用了相同的解码结果，因此并未引入任何独立的媒体数据，我们仅将这些结果报告为计数以及观察到的最大匹配比特数，而非作为额外的试验。 同一资源的转换副本以及一段音频的三种渲染版本共享同一个源文件，因此所观察到的比率及其精确的克洛珀-皮尔逊置信区间 [84] 均以未标记的源文件作为试验单位：共 85 张图像、46 段音频和 6 段视频。 所有置信区间均为 95% 的双侧置信区间。 我们还将匹配比特的分布与二项式零假设进行对比绘制。

paragraphs.en: A configuration’s false-positive evidence is analytic when an expected-payload test with P FM ≤ 10 − 6 P_{\mathrm{FM}}\leq 10^{-6} exists and no unmarked trial reached k k , and observed when no such test exists but the blind detector produced no false detection. Our target is a rate of at most 10 − 3 10^{-3} . Table 8 keeps the two kinds of evidence apart: the theoretical P FM P_{\mathrm{FM}} of each expected-payload test, and the observed counts with their source-level 95% upper bounds. Analytic evidence meets the target by construction, provided unmarked content decodes to bits that are independent of the expected payload; the match distributions in Section 4.4 are consistent with that assumption but cannot prove it. Observation alone does not establish the target for any configuration: with no false positive, the upper bound falls below 10 − 3 10^{-3} only after 3,688 independent sources, far more than our corpus holds.
paragraphs.zh: 当存在一个预期负载测试，其 P FM ≤ 10⁻⁶ P_{\mathrm{FM}}\leq 10^{-6}，且没有任何未标记试验达到 k k ，此时配置的错误阳性证据是分析性的；而当不存在此类测试，但盲检测器未产生任何错误检测时，该证据则为观察性的。 我们的目标是使该比率最多不超过 10⁻³ 10^{-3} 。 表 8 将这两种证据分开列出：每个预期负载测试的理论 P FM P_{\mathrm{FM}} ，以及观察到的计数及其源级别的 95% 上界。 只要未标记内容解码出的比特与预期负载相互独立，分析性证据就能通过构造满足该目标；第 4.4 节中的匹配分布与此假设一致，但无法证明其正确性。 仅凭观察无法为任何配置确立该目标：在没有错误阳性的情况下，只有当独立源的数量达到 3,688 个时，上界才会低于 10⁻³ 10^{-3} ，这远远超过了我们语料库所包含的数量。

paragraphs.en: Embedding latency was measured on an AWS g5.xlarge instance (NVIDIA A10G, 24 GB; AMD EPYC 7R32, 4 vCPU; PyTorch 2.14, CUDA 13.0) as the median over all corpus items, excluding the first item of each run (which includes lazy initialisation), with device synchronisation before and after each call. We report milliseconds per megapixel for images and video frames, and milliseconds of compute per second of audio. CPU latency was measured on the same host with four threads, as the median over four images (Kodak and DIV2K) or audio items after one warm-up item. Model loading time is excluded.
paragraphs.zh: 嵌入延迟是在 AWS g5.xlarge 实例（NVIDIA A10G，24 GB；AMD EPYC 7R32，4 vCPU；PyTorch 2.14，CUDA 13.0）上测量的，取所有语料库项的中位数，排除每次运行的第一项（包含惰性初始化），并在每次调用前后进行设备同步。 对于图像和视频帧，我们报告每兆像素的毫秒数；对于音频，则报告每秒的毫秒计算量。 CPU 延迟是在同一主机上使用四个线程测量的，取四张图像（Kodak 和 DIV2K）或音频项的中位数，且排除一个预热项。 模型加载时间不计入统计。

sents.en: Embedding latency was measured on an AWS g5.xlarge instance (NVIDIA A10G, 24 GB; AMD EPYC 7R32, 4 vCPU; PyTorch 2.14, CUDA 13.0) as the median over all corpus items, excluding the first item of each run (which includes lazy initialisation), with device synchronisation before and after each call.
sents.zh: 嵌入延迟是在 AWS g5.xlarge 实例（NVIDIA A10G，24 GB；AMD EPYC 7R32，4 vCPU；PyTorch 2.14，CUDA 13.0）上测量的，取所有语料库项的中位数，排除每次运行的第一项（包含惰性初始化），并在每次调用前后进行设备同步。

sents.en: We report milliseconds per megapixel for images and video frames, and milliseconds of compute per second of audio.
sents.zh: 对于图像和视频帧，我们报告每兆像素的毫秒数；对于音频，则报告每秒的毫秒计算量。

sents.en: CPU latency was measured on the same host with four threads, as the median over four images (Kodak and DIV2K) or audio items after one warm-up item.
sents.zh: CPU 延迟是在同一主机上使用四个线程测量的，取四张图像（Kodak 和 DIV2K）或音频项的中位数，且排除一个预热项。

sents.en: Model loading time is excluded.
sents.zh: 模型加载时间不计入统计。

paragraphs.en: Strength only scales the residual that the network adds, so settings of one network perform identical computation. Repeated settings nevertheless differed by up to about 20% in measured latency, which is timing noise. We therefore assign each configuration the median latency of its network, and treat differences between networks of less than about 10% as unresolved.
paragraphs.zh: 强度仅对网络所添加的残差进行缩放，因此同一网络的设置会执行相同的计算。 然而，重复设置的测量延迟最多相差约 20%，这属于定时噪声。 因此，我们将每个配置分配其网络的中位数延迟，并将网络间小于约 10% 的差异视为未解决。

paragraphs.en: Cost is an estimate of on-demand compute price per unit of media:

paragraphs.en: A configuration qualifies when (i) its code and weights are openly licensed, (ii) gate bit accuracy is at least 0.95 both pooled and on the worst subset, and (iii) its false-positive evidence is analytic or observed. The best-cost, best-speed and best-combined configurations in each table are chosen among qualifying configurations only: a fast method whose mark does not survive the gate transformation is not a usable operating point.
paragraphs.zh: 当且仅当满足以下条件时，一种配置才符合资格：(i) 其代码和权重采用开放许可；(ii) 门位精度在池化状态和最差子集上均至少为 0.95；以及 (iii) 其假阳性证据具有分析性或已被观测。 每张表格中成本最优、速度最优以及综合最优的配置仅从符合资格的配置中选择：一种速度快但其标记无法通过门变换的方法，并非可用的运行点。

paragraphs.en: The experimental unit is the source: an image, a video clip, or an audio clip together with its three sample-rate renderings. Means are over items, and their percentile bootstrap 95% intervals come from 10,000 resamples of sources, so that the three renderings of an audio clip are drawn together and the intervals reflect 46 independent audio sources rather than 138 inputs (Table 20 in the Appendix). Planned comparisons between the leading configurations use two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank tests on per-source differences [ 109 ] , averaging the renderings of an audio clip first, with Holm adjustment over the family of five tests [ 110 ] . Video results rest on six clips and are therefore descriptive; we do not claim significance for video differences.
paragraphs.zh: 实验单元是源数据：一张图像、一个视频片段，或一个音频片段及其三种采样率渲染版本。 均值是针对各项计算的，其百分位自助法 95% 置信区间来自对源数据的 10,000 次重采样，因此一个音频片段的三种渲染版本会被一同抽取，这些区间反映了 46 个独立的音频源，而非 138 个输入（见附录中的表 20）。 对领先配置进行计划性比较时，使用双侧 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验分析每个源数据的差异 [ 109 ]，首先对音频片段的渲染版本取平均值，并对五个检验构成的检验族进行 Holm 校正 [ 110 ]。 视频结果基于六个片段，因此仅具描述性；我们不对视频差异的显著性作出断言。

paragraphs.en: To test whether decoding is reproducible across hardware, we decoded the same compressed files on the benchmark host (x86-64, Linux) and on an Apple M-series machine (arm64, macOS), each with one and four CPU threads and with its accelerator (CUDA or MPS). Files were twelve Video Seal-marked clips (three clips, strengths 0.4 and 1.1, CRF 18 and 22) and one TrustMark-Q-marked image after JPEG 75. For each file we recorded the largest logit difference within one host and across hosts, the number of flipped bits, and whether decoded frames were byte-identical across hosts before and after conversion from YUV to RGB. To separate the colour conversion from the network, each host then converted the first 16 frames of every clip to RGB once and saved the arrays, and both hosts decoded both hosts’ arrays with the same TorchScript detector (a 2 × \times 2 design: input host by decoding host). Both hosts used PyAV 18.1.0 with libswscale 9.5.102.
paragraphs.zh: 为了测试解码结果在不同硬件上是否具有可重复性，我们在基准主机（x86-64，Linux）和一台 Apple M 系列机器（arm64，macOS）上对相同的压缩文件进行了解码，每台机器分别使用一个和四个 CPU 线程，并启用了各自的加速器（CUDA 或 MPS）。 这些文件包括十二个带有 Video Seal 标记的视频片段（三个片段，强度为 0.4 和 1.1，CRF 为 18 和 22），以及一个经过 JPEG 75 压缩的、带有 TrustMark-Q 标记的图片。 对于每个文件，我们记录了同一台主机内以及不同主机之间的最大 logit 差异、翻转的比特数，以及在从 YUV 转换为 RGB 前后，解码出的帧在不同主机上是否字节完全一致。 为了将颜色转换与网络部分分离，每台主机随后将每个片段的前 16 帧一次性转换为 RGB 并保存数组；接着，两台主机都使用相同的 TorchScript 检测器（采用 2 × 2 设计：输入主机与解码主机组合）对各自的主机所生成的数组进行解码。 两台主机均使用了 PyAV 18.1.0 和 libswscale 9.5.102。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 2 summarises the protocol. Each method fingerprints a set of registered assets and a larger set of distractors, which together form the registry. Registered assets are then transformed or partially edited and used as queries; media that were never registered go through the same transformations and serve as negative queries. Every query is searched exhaustively against the registry, and a threshold fixed on one half of the negatives decides whether the best match is reported. All randomness is seeded, so every method sees byte-identical queries.
paragraphs.zh: 图 2 总结了该协议。 每种方法都会对一组已注册资产和一组更大的干扰项进行特征提取，这些内容共同构成了注册表。 随后，已注册的资产会被转换或部分编辑，并用作查询；从未注册过的媒体则会经历相同的转换，并作为负向查询使用。 每个查询都会在注册表中进行全面搜索，并将阈值固定为负向匹配数的一半，以此决定是否报告最佳匹配结果。 所有随机性都通过种子初始化，因此每种方法都会看到字节完全相同的查询。

sents.en: Fig. 2 summarises the protocol.
sents.zh: 图 2 总结了该协议。

paragraphs.en: We included every fingerprinting method we could find that is distributed with an implementation and, where learned, with weights, and that targets natural images, music and speech, or natural video (Table 2 ). We recorded the licence of the code and, separately, of the weights and of the data they were trained on, because the three differ in several projects. A method is product-eligible (tier P) when code and weights carry a permissive licence (MIT, BSD, Apache-2.0 or CC0) and the weights were not trained on data restricted to non-commercial use. The strongest learned copy detectors are not: SSCD and the ISC21 winner are MIT-licensed code, but their weights carry no licence of their own and were trained on DISC21, whose repository is CC BY-NC 4.0; DINOHash has no licence file; and the neural music fingerprint NMFP is GPL-3.0. We measured them as reference points (tier R, marked † ), as the watermarking track does for its unlicensed checkpoints (Section 3.2 ). We excluded Apple NeuralHash (weights extracted from a device, no licence), PhotoDNA (licensed only for child-safety use), Adobe’s image comparator network (no public code), SuperPoint and TruFor (non-commercial weights), and Olaf and Panako, which we did not run: they are AGPL-3.0, whose network-use clause rules them out for a hosted provenance service, and Chromaprint and audfprint already represent their landmark and sub-band designs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们纳入了所有能找到的、随附实现代码的指纹识别方法；如果涉及训练，则需包含权重，且这些方法必须针对自然图像、音乐与语音或自然视频（表2）。 我们分别记录了代码的许可协议，以及权重和训练数据的许可协议，因为在多个项目中这三者的许可存在差异。 当代码和权重均采用宽松许可协议（MIT、BSD、Apache-2.0 或 CC0），且权重未基于限制为非商业用途的数据训练时，该方法即符合产品资格（P 级）。 最强的学习型复制检测器并不在此列：SSCD 和 ISC21 冠军的代码采用 MIT 许可，但其权重本身并无独立许可，且训练数据来自 DISC21（其仓库采用 CC BY-NC 4.0 许可）；DINOHash 没有许可文件；而神经音乐指纹 NMFP 则采用 GPL-3.0 许可。 我们将这些方法作为参考基准（R 级，标记为 †），正如水印研究领域中对待其无许可检查点的方式一样（第 3.2 节）。 我们排除了 Apple NeuralHash（权重从设备中提取，无许可协议）、PhotoDNA（仅许可用于儿童安全用途）、Adobe 的图像比较网络（无公开代码）、SuperPoint 和 TruFor（非商业用途的权重），以及 Olaf 和 Panako（我们未运行：它们采用 AGPL-3.0 许可，其网络使用条款使其无法用于托管的溯源服务）；此外，Chromaprint 和 audfprint 已分别代表了其标志性和子带设计。

sents.en: A method is product-eligible (tier P) when code and weights carry a permissive licence (MIT, BSD, Apache-2.0 or CC0) and the weights were not trained on data restricted to non-commercial use.
sents.zh: 当代码和权重均采用宽松许可协议（MIT、BSD、Apache-2.0 或 CC0），且权重未基于限制为非商业用途的数据训练时，该方法即符合产品资格（P 级）。

sents.en: The strongest learned copy detectors are not: SSCD and the ISC21 winner are MIT-licensed code, but their weights carry no licence of their own and were trained on DISC21, whose repository is CC BY-NC 4.0; DINOHash has no licence file; and the neural music fingerprint NMFP is GPL-3.0.
sents.zh: 最强的学习型复制检测器并不在此列：SSCD 和 ISC21 冠军的代码采用 MIT 许可，但其权重本身并无独立许可，且训练数据来自 DISC21（其仓库采用 CC BY-NC 4.0 许可）；DINOHash 没有许可文件；而神经音乐指纹 NMFP 则采用 GPL-3.0 许可。

sents.en: We measured them as reference points (tier R, marked † ), as the watermarking track does for its unlicensed checkpoints (Section 3.2 ).
sents.zh: 我们将这些方法作为参考基准（R 级，标记为 †），正如水印研究领域中对待其无许可检查点的方式一样（第 3.2 节）。

sents.en: We excluded Apple NeuralHash (weights extracted from a device, no licence), PhotoDNA (licensed only for child-safety use), Adobe’s image comparator network (no public code), SuperPoint and TruFor (non-commercial weights), and Olaf and Panako, which we did not run: they are AGPL-3.0, whose network-use clause rules them out for a hosted provenance service, and Chromaprint and audfprint already represent their landmark and sub-band designs.
sents.zh: 我们排除了 Apple NeuralHash（权重从设备中提取，无许可协议）、PhotoDNA（仅许可用于儿童安全用途）、Adobe 的图像比较网络（无公开代码）、SuperPoint 和 TruFor（非商业用途的权重），以及 Olaf 和 Panako（我们未运行：它们采用 AGPL-3.0 许可，其网络使用条款使其无法用于托管的溯源服务）；此外，Chromaprint 和 audfprint 已分别代表了其标志性和子带设计。

paragraphs.en: Twenty-one descriptors: PDQ [ 50 ] , with and without matching the query’s eight dihedral variants; aHash, dHash, pHash (64 and 256 bits) and wHash from imagehash [ 47 ] ; BlockMean, Marr–Hildreth and ColorMoment from OpenCV [ 49 ] ; Blockhash [ 48 ] ; the ISCC Image-Code at 64 bits (the ISO default) and 256 bits [ 15 ] ; DINOv2-S and DINOv2-B class tokens [ 54 ] ; a keyed 256-bit sign projection of DINOv2-S (below); OpenCLIP ViT-B/32 [ 56 ] ; SSCD with ResNet-50 and ResNeXt-101 backbones [ 52 ] ; the ISC21 descriptor-track winner [ 53 ] ; and DINOHash [ 58 ] . ISCC’s experimental semantic image code [ 57 ] ran in our pilot but not at full scale: it binarises an ISC21-derived descriptor that we evaluate directly, and its reference model runs one image at a time at about 3 s per image on a CPU core. Learned descriptors see the whole image resized to their square input without cropping, so that a crop attack cannot remove content the descriptor was never shown. Blockhash’s reference implementation loops over pixels in Python; we vectorised it and verified bit-identical output on five image sizes including odd ones.
paragraphs.zh: 二十一种描述符：PDQ [ 50 ]，分别匹配和不匹配查询中的八个二面角变体；来自 imagehash [ 47 ] 的 aHash、dHash、pHash（64 位和 256 位）以及 wHash；来自 OpenCV [ 49 ] 的 BlockMean、Marr–Hildreth 和 ColorMoment；Blockhash [ 48 ]；64 位（ISO 默认值）和 256 位的 ISCC Image-Code [ 15 ]；DINOv2-S 和 DINOv2-B 类标记 [ 54 ]；DINOv2-S 的带密钥的 256 位符号投影（见下文）；OpenCLIP ViT-B/32 [ 56 ]；使用 ResNet-50 和 ResNeXt-101 骨干网络的 SSCD [ 52 ]；ISC21 描述符跟踪竞赛的获胜者 [ 53 ]；以及 DINOHash [ 58 ]。 ISCC 的实验性语义图像代码 [ 57 ] 在我们的试点测试中运行过，但尚未达到完整规模：它将一个我们直接评估的源自 ISC21 的描述符进行二值化，其参考模型每次仅处理一张图像，在单个 CPU 核心上每张图像的运行时间约为 3 秒。 学习型描述符会看到整个图像被调整大小以匹配其方形输入，且不会进行裁剪，因此裁剪攻击无法移除描述符从未见过的内容。 Blockhash 的参考实现使用 Python 对像素进行循环处理；我们将其向量化，并在包括奇数尺寸在内的五种图像尺寸上验证了位级完全相同的输出。

sents.en: Twenty-one descriptors: PDQ [ 50 ] , with and without matching the query’s eight dihedral variants; aHash, dHash, pHash (64 and 256 bits) and wHash from imagehash [ 47 ] ; BlockMean, Marr–Hildreth and ColorMoment from OpenCV [ 49 ] ; Blockhash [ 48 ] ; the ISCC Image-Code at 64 bits (the ISO default) and 256 bits [ 15 ] ; DINOv2-S and DINOv2-B class tokens [ 54 ] ; a keyed 256-bit sign projection of DINOv2-S (below); OpenCLIP ViT-B/32 [ 56 ] ; SSCD with ResNet-50 and ResNeXt-101 backbones [ 52 ] ; the ISC21 descriptor-track winner [ 53 ] ; and DINOHash [ 58 ] .
sents.zh: 二十一种描述符：PDQ [ 50 ]，分别匹配和不匹配查询中的八个二面角变体；来自 imagehash [ 47 ] 的 aHash、dHash、pHash（64 位和 256 位）以及 wHash；来自 OpenCV [ 49 ] 的 BlockMean、Marr–Hildreth 和 ColorMoment；Blockhash [ 48 ]；64 位（ISO 默认值）和 256 位的 ISCC Image-Code [ 15 ]；DINOv2-S 和 DINOv2-B 类标记 [ 54 ]；DINOv2-S 的带密钥的 256 位符号投影（见下文）；OpenCLIP ViT-B/32 [ 56 ]；使用 ResNet-50 和 ResNeXt-101 骨干网络的 SSCD [ 52 ]；ISC21 描述符跟踪竞赛的获胜者 [ 53 ]；以及 DINOHash [ 58 ]。

sents.en: ISCC’s experimental semantic image code [ 57 ] ran in our pilot but not at full scale: it binarises an ISC21-derived descriptor that we evaluate directly, and its reference model runs one image at a time at about 3 s per image on a CPU core.
sents.zh: ISCC 的实验性语义图像代码 [ 57 ] 在我们的试点测试中运行过，但尚未达到完整规模：它将一个我们直接评估的源自 ISC21 的描述符进行二值化，其参考模型每次仅处理一张图像，在单个 CPU 核心上每张图像的运行时间约为 3 秒。

sents.en: Learned descriptors see the whole image resized to their square input without cropping, so that a crop attack cannot remove content the descriptor was never shown.
sents.zh: 学习型描述符会看到整个图像被调整大小以匹配其方形输入，且不会进行裁剪，因此裁剪攻击无法移除描述符从未见过的内容。

sents.en: Blockhash’s reference implementation loops over pixels in Python; we vectorised it and verified bit-identical output on five image sizes including odd ones.
sents.zh: Blockhash 的参考实现使用 Python 对像素进行循环处理；我们将其向量化，并在包括奇数尺寸在内的五种图像尺寸上验证了位级完全相同的输出。

paragraphs.en: DINOv2-S LSH-256 multiplies the L2-normalised DINOv2-S descriptor by a 384 × 256 384\times 256 Gaussian matrix drawn from a secret seed and keeps the signs. It is a standard random-hyperplane hash, included because it is compact, product-eligible and, unlike a raw descriptor, meaningless to anyone without the key; the security experiments test that claim.
paragraphs.zh: DINOv2-S LSH-256 将经过 L2 归一化的 DINOv2-S 描述符与一个源自秘密种子的 384 × 256 高斯矩阵相乘，并保留符号。 这是一种标准的随机超平面哈希方法，之所以被采用，是因为它结构紧凑、适合乘积运算，并且与原始描述符不同，没有密钥的人无法理解其含义；安全实验将验证这一主张。

sents.en: DINOv2-S LSH-256 multiplies the L2-normalised DINOv2-S descriptor by a 384 × 256 384\times 256 Gaussian matrix drawn from a secret seed and keeps the signs.
sents.zh: DINOv2-S LSH-256 将经过 L2 归一化的 DINOv2-S 描述符与一个源自秘密种子的 384 × 256 高斯矩阵相乘，并保留符号。

sents.en: It is a standard random-hyperplane hash, included because it is compact, product-eligible and, unlike a raw descriptor, meaningless to anyone without the key; the security experiments test that claim.
sents.zh: 这是一种标准的随机超平面哈希方法，之所以被采用，是因为它结构紧凑、适合乘积运算，并且与原始描述符不同，没有密钥的人无法理解其含义；安全实验将验证这一主张。

paragraphs.en: Chromaprint [ 73 ] , with candidate generation on the 20 most significant bits of each sub-fingerprint and verification by bit error rate at the voted offset (the AcoustID index design); the ISCC Audio-Code at 64 and 256 bits, computed from the whole-file Chromaprint vector; audfprint’s spectral-peak landmarks [ 70 ] , scored by the number of hashes that agree on one time offset; LAION-CLAP [ 111 ] as a semantic embedding, mean-pooled over 10 s windows; and NMFP [ 75 ] , a neural music fingerprint with 1 s segment embeddings, run in its authors’ TensorFlow environment and matched by segment voting.
paragraphs.zh: Chromaprint [ 73 ]，其候选生成基于每个子指纹中最显著的 20 位，并通过投票偏移量处的比特误码率进行验证（即 AcoustID 索引设计）；ISCC Audio-Code 采用 64 位和 256 位格式，由整个文件的 Chromaprint 向量计算得出；audfprint 的谱峰地标 [ 70 ]，通过在相同时间偏移量上一致的哈希数量进行评分；LAION-CLAP [ 111 ] 作为一种语义嵌入，在 10 秒窗口上进行均值池化；以及 NMFP [ 75 ]，一种神经音乐指纹，使用 1 秒分段的嵌入，在其作者的 TensorFlow 环境中运行并通过分段投票进行匹配。

paragraphs.en: vPDQ [ 66 ] at one hash per second, scoring a candidate by the share of query frames with a reference frame within Hamming distance 31; TMK+PDQF [ 50 , 65 ] , scored by its level-2 time-kernel similarity using Meta’s command-line tools; the ISCC Video-Code at 64 and 256 bits from MPEG-7 frame signatures [ 64 ] ; and DINOv2-S and SSCD on frames sampled at 1 fps, either mean-pooled into one clip descriptor or matched frame by frame with temporal voting, the baseline recipe of the 2023 Video Similarity Challenge [ 67 ] .
paragraphs.zh: vPDQ [ 66 ] 每秒处理一个哈希值，通过计算候选项与参考帧在汉明距离 31 范围内的查询帧所占比例进行评分；TMK+PDQF [ 50 , 65 ] 则使用 Meta 的命令行工具，通过其二级时间核相似性进行评分；ISCC Video-Code 基于 MPEG-7 帧签名，分别以 64 和 256 位进行评分 [ 64 ]；此外还有 DINOv2-S 和 SSCD，它们基于以 1 fps 采样得到的帧，这些帧可被平均池化为一个片段描述符，或逐帧匹配并结合时间投票，这是 2023 年视频相似性挑战赛的基准方案 [ 67 ]。

paragraphs.en: † Reference tier: weights without a licence, trained on non-commercial data, or copyleft code; measured for comparison, not product-eligible.
paragraphs.zh: † 参考层级：无许可的权重、在非商业数据上训练的模型，或采用知识共享许可的代码；仅用于比较测量，不符合产品资格。

paragraphs.en: Images. Amazon Berkeley Objects (ABO, CC BY 4.0) [ 112 ] supplies product photographs from real marketplace listings, the setting in which copied and relabelled product images circulate. We sampled 5,000 registered originals (one main image per product, shorter side at least 800 px), stored at a longer side of 1024 px as the asset a provenance service would register, and 100,000 distractors (one image per other product). Queries come from 2,000 registered originals; negative queries from 2,000 images of products that are neither registered nor distractors; and hard negatives from 1,000 other photographs of registered products. ABO reuses photographs across listings and colour variants, so before scoring we flagged pairs that are copies of each other under a rule fixed in advance on unattacked originals (PDQ distance at most 16 bits, SSCD cosine at least 0.80, or DINOv2-B cosine at least 0.95). The rule removed 6,015 distractors and 486 negative sources, and marked 54 of 1,000 hard negatives as recoloured versions of the registered photograph, which we report separately. As a second, literature-comparable set we fetched a subset of the DISC21 development split [ 12 ] : 3,000 ground-truth query–reference pairs, 3,000 queries without a reference, and 25,000 references in total. DISC21 is licensed for non-commercial research; we use it for measurement only.
paragraphs.zh: 图像。 Amazon Berkeley Objects（ABO，CC BY 4.0）[ 112 ]提供了来自真实市场商品列表的产品照片，这些照片正是被复制和重新标记的产品图像在其中传播的场景。 我们采样了5,000张已注册的原始图像（每个产品一张主图，短边至少为800像素），并将长边设为1024像素，作为溯源服务会登记的资产；此外还采样了100,000张干扰图像（每个其他产品一张图像）。 查询来自2,000张已注册的原始图像；负样本查询来自2,000张既非注册图像也非干扰图像的产品照片；而困难负样本则来自1,000张其他已注册产品的照片。 ABO在不同商品列表和颜色变体中重复使用照片，因此在评分之前，我们根据预先针对未受攻击的原始图像设定的规则，标记出互为复制的图像对（PDQ距离最多为16位，SSCD余弦相似度至少为0.80，或DINOv2-B余弦相似度至少为0.95）。 该规则移除了6,015张干扰图像和486个负样本来源，并将1,000个困难负样本中的54个标记为已注册照片的重新着色版本，这些结果我们将单独报告。 作为第二个可与文献中数据集相媲美的集合，我们获取了DISC21开发集的一个子集 [ 12 ]：3,000对具有真实标签的查询–参考图像对、3,000张没有参考图像的查询，以及总共25,000张参考图像。 DISC21的许可范围仅限非商业研究；我们仅将其用于测量。

paragraphs.en: Audio. 5,000 music tracks from the FMA large set [ 113 ] , restricted to tracks released under CC BY, CC BY-SA or CC0 and excluding the FMA-medium subset, and 1,750 LibriSpeech utterances of at least 8 s [ 106 ] , all at 22.05 kHz mono. Music clips are 30 s. Of these, 1,000 are registered, 5,350 are distractors and 400 are negative sources.

paragraphs.en: Video. Five-second clips cut every 5 s from four Blender open films [ 114 , 115 , 116 , 117 ] , skipping titles and end credits, and the first 5 s of 23 Xiph test sequences [ 108 ] , scaled to 1280 px wide at 25 fps and stored as H.264 at CRF 12: 120 registered, 323 distractor and 40 negative clips. Clips from the same film share style and characters, which makes the distractors deliberately hard.
paragraphs.zh: 视频。 从四部 Blender 开放电影 [ 114 , 115 , 116 , 117 ] 中每 5 秒截取一次五秒片段，跳过片头和片尾字幕；此外还截取了 23 个 Xiph 测试序列 [ 108 ] 的前 5 秒。所有片段均缩放至 1280 像素宽、25 fps 帧率，并以 H.264 编码（CRF 12）存储：共包含 120 个注册片段、323 个干扰片段和 40 个负例片段。 来自同一部电影的片段在风格和角色上具有相似性，这使得干扰片段被刻意设计得难以区分。

paragraphs.en: Images (35, grouped into families in Fig. 13 ): JPEG at quality 75, 50 and 30 and WebP at 50; downscaling to 0.5 and 0.25 and a 0.75 aspect change; centred crops keeping 90, 70, 50 and 30% of each side and an off-centre 50% crop; rotation by 5, 15 and 90 degrees, horizontal flip, perspective, skew and 25% padding; brightness, contrast, saturation, gamma, greyscale, blur, Gaussian noise and pixelation; text, emoji (30% of the image), meme caption, screenshot and overlay onto another photograph at half size, following AugLy [ 118 ] ; and two chains, a social-media chain (downscale, JPEG 70, 90% crop) and a re-capture simulation (perspective, defocus, sensor noise, tone curve, JPEG 80). Audio (20): MP3 and AAC at 64 kb/s, Opus at 24 kb/s, resampling through 8 kHz; white noise at 20 and 10 dB SNR and babble from other music at 10 and 0 dB; telephone band, 2 kHz low-pass, dynamic compression and reverberation; pitch + 2 +2 semitones, tempo 0.9 and 1.1 and speed 1.05; excerpts of 10 and 5 s at a random offset, an excerpt with MP3 and noise, and a re-recording simulation. Unlike the watermarking track, codec outputs are not re-aligned: a fingerprint must cope with codec delay itself. Video (24): H.264 at CRF 28 and 35, H.265 at CRF 32; downscaling to 0.5 and 0.25; 75% and 50% crops; flip, 90 and 5 degree rotation, letterboxing; greyscale, brightness, contrast, blur and noise; text caption, logo, and picture-in-picture at half size on another clip; 15 fps, 1.25 × \times speed, a 2.5 s excerpt, the same 2.5 s inserted into 5 s of another clip, and a screen-recording simulation.
