paragraphs.en: A registry compares a fingerprint computed at signing time with one computed at lookup time, possibly on different hardware. We fingerprinted the same 200 PNG files (100 registered originals and their JPEG-75 copies, byte-identical on both hosts) on the AMD EPYC and NVIDIA A10G host and on an Apple M5 Pro laptop (Fig. 23 ). PDQ, the imagehash DCT and difference hashes, BlockMean, Blockhash and the ISCC codes were bit-identical on every image, and the float descriptors agreed to 1 − cos ≤ 1-\cos\leq 0.00014. Two classical hashes were not deterministic: the Marr–Hildreth hash differed on 89% of images by up to 64 of its 576 bits, enough to push 23 of the 200 self-comparisons below its own match threshold, and wHash differed on 14% by up to 31 of 64 bits. Both depend on floating-point filtering whose result differs between processor architectures; a service that fingerprints on one platform and verifies on another should avoid them or pin the implementation.
paragraphs.zh: 注册表会将签名时计算的指纹与查找时计算的指纹进行比较，而这两者可能是在不同的硬件上计算的。 我们在 AMD EPYC 和 NVIDIA A10G 主机以及一台 Apple M5 Pro 笔记本电脑上，对相同的 200 个 PNG 文件（包括 100 个已注册的原始文件及其 JPEG-75 副本，这些文件在两台主机上的字节完全相同）进行了指纹提取（图 23）。 PDQ、imagehash DCT 和差异哈希、BlockMean、Blockhash 以及 ISCC 代码在所有图像上都是比特相同的，而浮点描述符的一致性达到了 1 − cos ≤ 0.00014。 两种经典哈希并非确定性的：Marr–Hildreth 哈希在 89% 的图像上存在差异，最多有 576 个比特中的 64 个不同，这足以使 200 次自我比较中有 23 次的结果低于其自身的匹配阈值；而 wHash 在 14% 的图像上存在差异，最多有 64 个比特中的 31 个不同。 这两种哈希都依赖于浮点运算过滤，其结果会因处理器架构而异；因此，若服务在一个平台上进行指纹提取而在另一个平台上进行验证，则应避免使用这些哈希，或固定其实现方式。

sents.en: A registry compares a fingerprint computed at signing time with one computed at lookup time, possibly on different hardware.

sents.zh: 两种经典哈希并非确定性的：Marr–Hildreth 哈希在 89% 的图像上存在差异，最多有 576 个比特中的 64 个不同，这足以使 200 次自我比较中有 23 次的结果低于其自身的匹配阈值；而 wHash 在 14% 的图像上存在差异，最多有 64 个比特中的 31 个不同。

sents.zh: 这两种哈希都依赖于浮点运算过滤，其结果会因处理器架构而异；因此，若服务在一个平台上进行指纹提取而在另一个平台上进行验证，则应避免使用这些哈希，或固定其实现方式。

paragraphs.en: We timed extraction separately on the otherwise idle A10G host (AMD EPYC 7R32), because the timings recorded during the benchmark include contention from dozens of concurrent workers. Each image method fingerprinted the same 256 registered originals at 1024 pixels on the long side, CPU methods on a single thread and learned methods on the GPU in batches of 64 including the host-to-device copy. The hashes cost between 1.0 (BlockMean) and 63 ms (wHash) per image on one CPU thread, with PDQ at 31 ms and the ISCC Image-Code at 11 ms; the learned descriptors cost 1.1–8.3 ms on the GPU (DINOv2-S 2.0, SSCD-R50 2.7, ISC21 8.3). None of these costs matters for a signing service: on the same on-demand instance, fingerprinting a million images costs about US$1.29 with PDQ on its eight vCPUs, US$0.66 with DINOv2-S and US$2.81 with ISC21 on its GPU, before decoding. Storage differs more: PDQ, the ISCC codes and the keyed projection need 8–32 bytes per asset, a float DINOv2-S descriptor 1.5 kB. Audio fingerprints ran at 1.4–2.0 ms per second of audio (CLAP 1.1 ms on the GPU), and video fingerprints at 51 ms (TMK+PDQF) to 132 ms (vPDQ) per second of video on one CPU thread and 136 ms for frame-level DINOv2-S, dominated in every case by decoding and frame sampling. We did not time registry search at scale; exact search over our 98,985-item image index was not the bottleneck at any point.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在原本空闲的 A10G 主机（AMD EPYC 7R32）上单独计时了提取过程，因为基准测试中记录的时间包含了数十个并发工作线程带来的竞争影响。 每种图像方法都对相同的 256 张已注册的原始图像进行指纹识别，长边分辨率为 1024 像素；CPU 方法使用单线程，而学习型方法则在 GPU 上以每次 64 张的批次处理，包含从主机到设备的复制过程。 在单个 CPU 线程上，每张图片的哈希计算耗时介于 1.0（BlockMean）至 63 毫秒（wHash）之间，其中 PDQ 为 31 毫秒，ISCC Image-Code 为 11 毫秒；学习型描述符在 GPU 上的耗时为 1.1–8.3 毫秒（DINOv2-S 为 2.0，SSCD-R50 为 2.7，ISC21 为 8.3）。 对于签名服务而言，这些成本均无关紧要：在同一按需实例上，对一百万张图片进行指纹识别，使用 PDQ 在八个 vCPU 上的成本约为 1.29 美元，使用 DINOv2-S 为 0.66 美元，而使用 ISC21 在 GPU 上的成本为 2.81 美元（未包含解码）。 存储需求差异更大：PDQ、ISCC 码和带密钥的投影方法每个资产需要 8–32 字节，而一个浮点型 DINOv2-S 描述符则需要 1.5 kB。 音频指纹识别的耗时为每秒 1.4–2.0 毫秒（CLAP 在 GPU 上为 1.1 毫秒），视频指纹识别则在单个 CPU 线程上每秒钟视频耗时 51 毫秒（TMK+PDQF）至 132 毫秒（vPDQ），而帧级 DINOv2-S 的耗时为 136 毫秒；在所有情况下，解码和帧采样都是主要耗时环节。 我们没有对大规模注册表搜索进行计时；在我们包含 98,985 个项目的图像索引中，精确搜索在任何阶段都不是性能瓶颈。

paragraphs.en: The registered assets of the fingerprinting track were also watermarked with one openly licensed model per modality from the watermarking track, and the marked copies went through the fingerprinting track’s transformations (Section 3.3 ). This measures, on identical media and attacks, the coverage of each family’s decision rule and their complementarity. The union of their successes describes combined coverage; a deployed watermark-first cascade would also need to handle incorrect and ambiguous keys. Table 19 and Fig. 24 combine each modality’s MIT-licensed watermark with its fingerprints on the same attacked copies of watermarked assets. The two satisfy their respective success criteria on different queries. For images, TrustMark yields its key for 62% of attacked copies and DINOv2-S identifies 61%; the union of these successes covers 69%, and 78% with the ISC21 descriptor. The watermark alone survives additive noise, emoji and text overlays, perspective and the re-capture chain better than DINOv2-S; the fingerprint alone survives the meme layout, padding, a 5-degree rotation and skew, which move the watermark out of TrustMark’s decoding grid. Neither survives large crops, rotations of 15 degrees or more, screenshots or overlays onto another photograph (Fig. 24 a). For audio the fingerprint covers more queries: AudioSeal returned the exact 16-bit key for 24% of queries (23.9% if recoveries of the 2 assets that share a key are not counted as identification) and Chromaprint identified 67%, and the watermark added a useful share only under telephone filtering and loud babble; nothing survived pitch, tempo or speed changes. For video expected-key watermark verification covers more queries: Video Seal passed that test for 92% of queries, including the crops, flips, rotations, letterboxing and insertions that break every video fingerprint, and the fingerprints added almost nothing (a few screen recordings); picture-in-picture defeated both. These union rates describe complementary coverage, not the measured accuracy of a deployed cascade; the video result does not establish unique registry-ID recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 指纹识别流程中的已注册资产也使用水印流程中每个模态的一个开放许可模型进行了水印标记，而经过标记的副本则通过了指纹识别流程的转换（第 3.3 节）。 这项测试在相同的媒体和攻击条件下，衡量了每个家族决策规则的覆盖范围及其互补性。 它们成功操作的并集描述了联合覆盖范围；一个部署“先水印”的级联系统还需要处理错误和模糊的密钥。 表 19 和图 24 将每种模态的 MIT 许可水印与同一批受攻击的水印资产副本上的指纹相结合。 两者在不同的查询中分别满足各自的成功标准。 对于图像，TrustMark 在 62% 的受攻击副本中返回了其密钥，DINOv2-S 则识别出 61%；这些成功操作的并集覆盖了 69%，若加入 ISC21 描述符则覆盖 78%。 仅凭水印本身比 DINOv2-S 更能抵抗加性噪声、表情符号和文本叠加、透视变换以及重新捕获链；仅凭指纹本身则能抵抗表情包布局、填充、5 度旋转和倾斜，这些操作会将水印移出 TrustMark 的解码网格。 两者都无法承受大幅裁剪、15 度或更大的旋转、截图或叠加到另一张照片上（图 24 a）。 对于音频，指纹覆盖了更多查询：AudioSeal 在 24% 的查询中返回了精确的 16 位密钥（如果共享同一密钥的 2 个资产的恢复结果不被视为识别成功，则为 23.9%），Chromaprint 识别出 67%，而水印仅在电话滤波和大声背景噪音的情况下提供了有效帮助；没有任何方法能抵抗音高、节奏或速度变化。 对于视频，预期密钥的水印验证覆盖了更多查询：Video Seal 在 92% 的查询中通过了该测试，包括那些会破坏所有视频指纹的裁剪、翻转、旋转、黑边填充和插入操作，而指纹本身几乎未带来额外效果（仅少数屏幕录制受影响）；画中画则同时破坏了两者。 这些并集比率描述了互补覆盖范围，而非部署级联系统的实际准确率；视频测试结果并未证明能够唯一恢复注册 ID。

paragraphs.en: Embedding the watermark is itself a transformation. For 62.0% of the watermarked images the ISCC Image-Code of the marked image no longer matched the unmarked original at the operating threshold, and for 17.7% with SSCD, against 0.3% for PDQ and 5.7% for DINOv2-S. We attribute the ISCC case to the same step that makes it survive padding: on product shots with white backgrounds, a faint residual in the border changes what the uniform-border trim removes, and the security experiments show the same sensitivity to imperceptible perturbations. A registry that stores the fingerprint of the unmarked original therefore loses matches: ISCC’s detection of attacked marked copies fell from 47% to 19% when the registry held the unmarked fingerprint. The fingerprint must be computed on the published, watermarked asset.
paragraphs.zh: 嵌入水印本身就是一种转换。 对于 62.0% 的带水印图像，在操作阈值下，标记后图像的 ISCC 图像代码不再与未标记的原图匹配；而对于 SSCD，这一比例为 17.7%，相比之下 PDQ 为 0.3%，DINOv2-S 为 5.7%。 我们将 ISCC 的情况归因于使其能够承受填充处理的同一步骤：在具有白色背景的产品照片中，边框中微弱的残留物会改变均匀边框裁剪所移除的内容，而安全实验也显示出对不可察觉扰动的相同敏感性。 因此，存储未标记原图指纹的注册表会失去匹配项：当注册表中包含未标记指纹时，ISCC 对受攻击的标记副本的检测率从 47% 下降到了 19%。 指纹必须基于已发布且带有水印的资产进行计算。

paragraphs.en: On never-registered, unmarked images TrustMark’s error-correcting decoder returned a valid codeword for 2.71% of 18,000 attacked queries (a detection; these decodes were not compared with the registered keys), in line with its blind false-positive rates in the watermarking track (Section 4.4 ); AudioSeal’s detector fired on 1 of 8,400 attacked queries from 400 never-registered tracks, and that detection’s message equalled none of the 199 distinct registered keys; and Video Seal, whose key needs agreement on far more bits, matched a registered key for 0.00%. A cascade must check a decoded key against the registry before trusting it, exactly as it thresholds a fingerprint match.
paragraphs.zh: 对于从未注册且未标记的图像，TrustMark 的错误纠正解码器在 18,000 个受攻击查询中，对 2.71% 的查询返回了有效的码字（一次检测；这些解码结果未与已注册的密钥进行比较），这与它在数字水印领域中的盲检误报率一致（第 4.4 节）；AudioSeal 的检测器在来自 400 个从未注册音轨的 8,400 个受攻击查询中，对其中 1 个进行了检测，而该检测结果的消息与 199 个不同的已注册密钥均不匹配；至于 Video Seal，其密钥需要同意更多比特的信息，却仅有 0.00% 的情况与已注册密钥匹配。 级联系统必须在信任一个解码出的密钥之前，先将其与注册表进行比对，这与其对指纹匹配结果进行阈值判断的过程完全相同。

sents.en: On never-registered, unmarked images TrustMark’s error-correcting decoder returned a valid codeword for 2.71% of 18,000 attacked queries (a detection; these decodes were not compared with the registered keys), in line with its blind false-positive rates in the watermarking track (Section 4.4 ); AudioSeal’s detector fired on 1 of 8,400 attacked queries from 400 never-registered tracks, and that detection’s message equalled none of the 199 distinct registered keys; and Video Seal, whose key needs agreement on far more bits, matched a registered key for 0.00%.

sents.en: A cascade must check a decoded key against the registry before trusting it, exactly as it thresholds a fingerprint match.
sents.zh: 级联系统必须在信任一个解码出的密钥之前，先将其与注册表进行比对，这与其对指纹匹配结果进行阈值判断的过程完全相同。

paragraphs.en: No single soft binding serves every purpose, and the results argue for a layered design with a different lead family per modality. For images, a watermark and a fingerprint recover about the same share of attacked copies but different ones, so the union of their successes covers 69% of attacked copies with TrustMark and DINOv2-S, against 62% and 61% for either alone (Section 6 ). Among openly licensed watermarks, PixelSeal at a strength just above its robustness threshold is the best balance of perceptibility, robustness and speed; its margin at 0.15 is small on small images, so a deployment expecting heavier compression should move towards the default of 0.2 (Section 4.1 ). Among openly licensed fingerprints, a DINOv2 embedding recovers the most copies and is the only one that survives large crops and rotations; its keyed 256-bit projection costs a few points of detection, and stores in the same 32 bytes as PDQ. In the evaluated inversion experiment, a decoder trained under a different key did not identify the source above chance (Section 5.6 ); this does not establish that no attacker can invert it. The registered open standard, the ISCC Image-Code, is precise but loses roughly half of the transformed copies. For audio, fingerprints cover more queries: Chromaprint and audfprint recover far more attacked copies than the 16-bit AudioSeal key, whose base model is nevertheless the best watermark operating point. For video, expected-key watermark verification covers more queries: in the combination experiment Video Seal passed that test after the crops, flips and insertions that break every open video fingerprint, and in the watermarking track PixelSeal at 0.4 was the best-balanced video watermark. The strongest image copy detectors, SSCD and the ISC21 winner, would add a further 6–10 points but cannot be shipped as released, because their weights were trained on data licensed for non-commercial research.
paragraphs.zh: 没有任何一种单一的软绑定能适用于所有用途，实验结果也支持采用分层设计，即每种模态使用不同的主智能体家族。 对于图像而言，水印和指纹能够恢复被攻击副本中大致相同比例的样本，但具体恢复的副本不同；因此，二者的成功检测范围合并后，通过 TrustMark 和 DINOv2-S 可覆盖 69% 的被攻击副本，而单独使用其中任何一种仅能覆盖 62% 或 61%（第 6 节）。 在开放许可的水印中，PixelSeal 的强度略高于其鲁棒性阈值时，在可感知性、鲁棒性和速度之间实现了最佳平衡；但在小尺寸图像上，其 0.15 的容差范围较小，因此若部署环境需要更强的压缩能力，则应转向默认的 0.2（第 4.1 节）。 在开放许可的指纹中，DINOv2 嵌入能够恢复最多的副本，也是唯一能抵抗大幅裁剪和旋转的指纹；其带密钥的 256 位投影会略微降低检测率，但存储占用与 PDQ 相同的 32 字节。 在评估的反向生成实验中，使用不同密钥训练的解码器未能以高于随机水平的概率识别出源数据（第 5.6 节）；但这并不能证明不存在能够反向生成该水印的攻击者。 已注册的开放标准 ISCC Image-Code 虽然精确，但会丢失大约一半的转换后副本。 对于音频而言，指纹能覆盖更多查询：Chromaprint 和 audfprint 恢复的被攻击副本数量远多于 16 位 AudioSeal 密钥，尽管后者基础模型仍是最佳的水印运行点。 对于视频而言，基于预期密钥的水印验证能覆盖更多查询：在组合实验中，Video Seal 在经过所有开放视频指纹都无法通过的裁剪、翻转和插入操作后仍通过了测试；在水印专项测试中，强度为 0.4 的 PixelSeal 是平衡性最佳的视频水印。 最强的图像副本检测器 SSCD 和 ISC21 冠军模型可额外提升 6–10 个百分点，但由于其权重是在仅允许非商业研究的数据上训练的，因此无法以发布版本直接部署。

paragraphs.en: For both families the false-match rate belongs to the complete decision rule, not to the model. TrustMark’s error-correcting decoder reports a valid codeword on several percent of unmarked images, yet none of the same decodes reached the expected-payload threshold on any of the 85 unmarked images (Section 4.4 ); a provenance verifier resolves a soft binding against a manifest and can apply that test. The combination experiment shows the same for keys decoded from attacked, never-registered content (Section 6 ): a decoded key must be checked against the registry exactly as a fingerprint score is thresholded. Payload size limits what can be shown. With 16 bits, even an exact match leaves a chance of 1.5 × 10 − 5 1.5\times 10^{-5} per key, so the 16-bit audio models rest on their blind detectors, whose observed bound over 46 clips does not establish 10 − 3 10^{-3} . For fingerprints, N ​ p Np is the expected number of false matches per negative query for N N references and average pair-level false-match probability p p , and bounds the probability of at least one false match from above. A pair-level rate at most 10 − 9 10^{-9} would therefore suffice for a 1% query-level bound at 10 7 10^{7} assets; this operating point is below the empirically resolved range here. We expected a second, geometric verification stage to supply the missing precision, and measured it; under a matched calibration false-binding constraint it did not raise detection in the evaluated image pipelines, because the remaining false matches are near-copies of registered designs that also match geometrically (Section 5.2 ). What alignment against the stored original does provide is localization of an edit, most of which survives when the original must first be retrieved.
paragraphs.zh: 对于这两个家族而言，错误匹配率属于完整的决策规则，而非模型本身。 TrustMark 的纠错解码器在若干百分比的未标记图像中报告了有效的码字，但在 85 张未标记图像中，没有任何一个解码结果达到预期有效载荷阈值（第 4.4 节）；来源验证器可将软绑定与清单进行比对，并执行该测试。 组合实验表明，从受攻击且从未注册的内容中解码出的密钥也存在相同问题（第 6 节）：解码后的密钥必须像指纹得分被设定阈值一样，与注册表进行严格比对。 有效载荷的大小限制了我们能够展示的内容。 在 16 位的情况下，即使完全匹配，每个密钥仍存在 1.5 × 10⁻⁵ 的偶然性，因此 16 位音频模型依赖于其盲检测器，而该检测器在 46 个片段上观察到的界限并未达到 10⁻³。 对于指纹而言，N_p 是 N 个参考项和平均对级错误匹配概率 p 下，每次负向查询的预期错误匹配数量，并且它从上方界定了至少出现一次错误匹配的概率。 因此，若对级错误匹配率不超过 10⁻⁹，则在 10⁷ 个资产中即可实现 1% 的查询级界限；这一工作点低于此处经验性确定的范围。 我们曾预期第二个几何验证阶段能够提供缺失的精度，并对此进行了测量；在匹配校准的虚假绑定约束下，该阶段并未提升所评估图像处理流程中的检测能力，因为剩余的错误匹配是已注册设计的近似复制品，这些复制品在几何上也能匹配（第 5.2 节）。 与存储的原始内容进行比对所提供的，是对编辑位置的定位，而大部分编辑内容在必须首先检索原始内容时仍然存在。

paragraphs.en: The largest effect in the fingerprinting track is not the choice of method but the treatment of variants: when recoloured or re-mounted versions of one design count as distinct assets, every method’s calibrated detection falls to 0.24 or less. Learned descriptors bind such variants far more readily than hashes, which is correct if the question is “is this the same artwork” and wrong if it is “is this the asset this manifest was signed for”. A soft-binding service must decide which question it answers, group variants of a design under one registry entry if it answers the first, and treat a match as a pointer to candidate manifests rather than as an identification.
paragraphs.zh: 在指纹识别领域，影响最大的因素并非方法的选择，而是对变体的处理方式：当同一设计的重新着色或重新装裱版本被视为不同的资产时，所有方法的校准检测率都会降至 0.24 或更低。 学习到的描述符比哈希值更容易绑定这类变体；如果问题在于“这是不是同一件艺术品”，这种处理方式是正确的，但如果问题在于“这是不是该清单所签署的资产”，则这种处理方式是错误的。 软绑定服务必须明确自己要回答哪个问题：如果回答第一个问题，就需要将同一设计的变体归入同一个注册表条目；如果回答第二个问题，则需将匹配结果视为指向候选清单的指针，而非身份确认。

paragraphs.en: White-box attacks evaded every learned fingerprint with perturbations of a few grey levels, surrogate gradients evaded the DCT hashes, targeted forgeries bound unrelated images to registered assets, and pitch, tempo or small crops broke the audio and video fingerprints. Regeneration and adversarial attacks are known to remove or evade pixel-level watermarks [ 78 , 79 ] ; our watermarking track measured routine processing only. A soft-binding match should therefore be presented as a pointer to a candidate manifest that must be confirmed, never as evidence that content is authentic. The value written into a c2pa.soft-binding assertion is disclosed to everyone who reads the manifest, and our inversion decoder recovered recognisable thumbnails from unkeyed descriptors and hashes, so services should keep raw descriptors server-side and publish only keyed or opaque identifiers.
paragraphs.zh: 白盒攻击通过少量灰度级别的扰动规避了所有已学习的指纹；代理梯度攻击规避了 DCT 哈希；定向伪造将无关图像与已注册资产绑定；而音高、速度或小型裁剪则破坏了音频和视频指纹。 已知再生和对抗性攻击能够移除或规避像素级水印 [78, 79]；我们的水印研究仅测量了常规处理过程。 因此，软绑定匹配应被呈现为指向候选清单的指针，该清单必须经过确认，而绝不能作为内容真实性的证据。 写入 c2pa.soft-binding 断言中的值会向所有读取清单的人公开，并且我们的反演解码器能够从未加密的描述符和哈希中恢复出可识别的缩略图，因此服务应将原始描述符保留在服务器端，仅发布已加密或不透明的标识符。

paragraphs.en: Embedding a watermark is itself a transformation. It moved the ISCC Image-Code of 62.0% of images past its own match threshold, and a registry holding the fingerprint of the unmarked original lost matches accordingly (Section 6 ). A service that does both must compute the fingerprint on the watermarked asset it publishes.
paragraphs.zh: 嵌入水印本身就是一种转换。 它将 62.0% 图像的 ISCC 图像代码提升至其自身的匹配阈值之上，而存储未标记原始文件指纹的注册表也因此失去了相应的匹配结果（第 6 节）。 同时执行这两项操作的服务必须对已发布的水印资产计算其指纹。

sents.en: Embedding a watermark is itself a transformation.
sents.zh: 嵌入水印本身就是一种转换。

sents.en: It moved the ISCC Image-Code of 62.0% of images past its own match threshold, and a registry holding the fingerprint of the unmarked original lost matches accordingly (Section 6 ).
sents.zh: 它将 62.0% 图像的 ISCC 图像代码提升至其自身的匹配阈值之上，而存储未标记原始文件指纹的注册表也因此失去了相应的匹配结果（第 6 节）。

sents.en: A service that does both must compute the fingerprint on the watermarked asset it publishes.
sents.zh: 同时执行这两项操作的服务必须对已发布的水印资产计算其指纹。

paragraphs.en: Provenance claims should not depend on which machine checks them. A watermark decoded on an x86 host lost payload bits on an arm64 host; given identical RGB arrays both hosts agreed to within floating-point noise, so the cause is the platform-specific conversion from YUV to RGB that feeds the detector (Section 4.6 ). Converting colour in a fixed, portable implementation, or running detectors on YUV input, would remove the effect. Two classical image hashes, Marr–Hildreth and wHash, were likewise not bit-identical across architectures. Reproducing a benchmark also needs more pinned than its corpus: our two runs of the audio fingerprint track drew different background music for the babble transformations, because the pool came from incidental surplus downloads, and the results moved accordingly until the pool was pinned.
paragraphs.zh: 来源声明不应取决于由哪台机器进行验证。 一个在 x86 主机上解码的水印，在 arm64 主机上丢失了有效载荷位；尽管两台主机对相同的 RGB 数组的判定结果在浮点噪声范围内一致，但问题根源在于将 YUV 转换为 RGB 的平台特定转换过程（第 4.6 节）。 通过固定且便携的实现方式转换颜色，或在 YUV 输入上运行检测器，即可消除这一影响。 两种经典的图像哈希算法——Marr–Hildreth 和 wHash——在不同架构上的结果同样并非逐位相同。 复现一项基准测试还需要比其语料库更多的固定数据：我们对音频指纹任务的两次运行中，用于 babble 转换的背景音乐不同，因为初始数据池来自偶然多余的下载内容，因此结果也随之变化，直到数据池被固定下来。

paragraphs.en: The watermark corpus is small by the standards of model training (85 images, 138 audio inputs from 46 clips, six 2.5-s video clips); it separates the methods on the gate and on false positives, but the video comparisons are descriptive, FLIP and ColorVideoVDP were computed on subsets, and PESQ is reported on speech only. ABO, the fingerprint image corpus, is a product-photo catalogue whose white backgrounds and repeated designs make some things harder and others easier than natural photographs, as the comparison with DISC21 shows. The fingerprint audio negatives are music only. The video calibration set contains 500 queries from 20 negative clips and supports reporting the query-level 1% and pair-level 10 − 4 10^{-4} targets under our resolution rule, with limited precision. The achieved held-out query-level false-match rates exceed the 1% calibration target. Source-clip resampling accounts for transformations of the same clip, but does not by itself account for dependence between clips from the same film. The security experiments used small samples and simple attacks, so they bound attack difficulty from above. Latency was measured on one GPU type, and cost estimates use on-demand prices at one date and assume full utilisation. Strength settings were chosen around each method’s default and do not trace a full rate–distortion curve. The licence status of several models changed during 2024–2026; we report the status recorded at the time of measurement.
paragraphs.zh: 该水印语料库在模型训练的标准下规模较小（85 张图像、来自 46 个剪辑的 138 段音频输入以及六个时长为 2.5 秒的视频剪辑）；它区分了基于门控的方法和基于假阳性的方法，但视频比较仅具有描述性，FLIP 和 ColorVideoVDP 是在子集上计算的，而 PESQ 仅针对语音进行了报告。 ABO（指纹图像语料库）是一个产品图片目录，其白色背景和重复的设计使得某些操作比自然照片更难，而另一些则更容易，正如与 DISC21 的比较所显示的那样。 指纹音频的负样本仅包含音乐。 视频校准集包含来自 20 个负样本剪辑的 500 条查询，并支持在遵循我们的分辨率规则的情况下报告查询级别的 1% 目标和成对级别的 10^{-4} 目标，但精度有限。 实际达到的保留查询级别的假匹配率超过了 1% 的校准目标。 源剪辑的重采样考虑了同一剪辑的变换，但本身并未考虑来自同一影片的不同剪辑之间的依赖关系。 安全实验使用了小样本和简单的攻击方式，因此它们从上限界定了攻击难度。 延迟是在一种 GPU 类型上测量的，而成本估算则基于某一日期的一次性价格，并假设了完全利用。 强度设置是围绕每种方法的默认值选择的，并未追踪完整的速率-失真曲线。 2024 年至 2026 年期间，多个模型的许可状态发生了变化；我们报告的是测量时记录的状态。

paragraphs.en: We compared openly available watermarks and fingerprints for images, audio and video as soft bindings for content provenance, under one protocol, on licence-audited public media and at calibrated false-match rates. For images, PixelSeal and a DINOv2 embedding are the strongest shippable watermark and fingerprint, and they fail on different copies; fingerprints cover more attacked audio copies, while expected-key watermark verification covers more video copies. The strongest fingerprints cannot be shipped as released, and the one open fingerprint on the C2PA list, the ISCC code, is precise but loses half of the transformed copies. Five findings concern the design of a soft-binding service more than the choice of a model. False matches are a property of the decision rule, so decoded keys must be checked against the expected payload or the registry. Catalogue variants dominate the fingerprint false-match budget, and no detection improvement from geometric verification was observed under a matched calibration false-binding constraint in the evaluated image pipelines. Neither family resists an adversary who knows the method, and unkeyed fingerprints leak content when published. Watermarking moves fingerprints, so the published asset must be the one fingerprinted. And colour conversion that differs across platforms changes decoded watermark bits.
paragraphs.zh: 我们按照统一协议，在经许可审核的公共媒体上，以校准后的误匹配率水平，将公开可用的图像、音频和视频水印与指纹作为内容来源的软绑定进行了比较。 对于图像而言，PixelSeal 和 DINOv2 嵌入是性能最强的可部署水印与指纹，但它们在复制版本上的表现存在差异；指纹能覆盖更多经过攻击的音频复制版本，而预期密钥水印验证则能覆盖更多视频复制版本。 性能最强的指纹无法作为已发布内容直接部署，而 C2PA 列表中唯一公开可用的指纹——ISCC 码——虽然精准，却会丢失一半的转换后复制版本。 五项发现更关注软绑定服务的设计，而非模型的选择。 误匹配是决策规则的特性，因此必须将解码后的密钥与预期负载或注册表进行核对。 目录变体占据了指纹误匹配的主要部分，在评估的图像处理流程中，即便在匹配校准的软绑定约束条件下，几何验证也未带来任何检测能力的提升。 这两类方法都无法抵御了解其原理的对手，而未加密的指纹一旦发布就会泄露内容。 水印技术会改变指纹，因此必须确保发布的内容正是经过指纹识别的那个版本。 此外，不同平台间存在差异的颜色转换会改变解码后的水印比特。

paragraphs.en: The benchmark scripts for both tracks, the corpus manifests with source URLs and SHA-256 hashes, the weight and source lockfiles, the per-configuration, per-method and per-query results, and the scripts that generate every table, figure and cited number in this paper are publicly available at https://github.com/Original-Pictures/soft-bindings-benchmark (release v1.0, which also contains the LaTeX source of this version). Rebuilding the paper from that release regenerates every number from the committed results. Corpus media are not redistributed; each item can be retrieved from its original source and verified against the manifest. DISC21 was used under its non-commercial research licence and ABO under CC BY 4.0.

paragraphs.en: The authors used Claude (Anthropic), a large language model, in preparing this work. Claude drafted the manuscript text; wrote the benchmark orchestration, analysis and figure-generation code; searched for and verified the bibliographic references against publisher, Crossref, arXiv and repository records; and produced the figures from the recorded results. Claude also assisted with the revision after internal review, including the re-analysis of the recorded results described in the text. The authors designed the study, ran and supervised the measurements, reviewed the analysis code and its outputs, reviewed and edited all text, and take full responsibility for the content of this article. Every number, table and figure in the article is generated by scripts from the recorded results (Data and Code Availability). No AI system is listed as an author.

sents.zh: 在子集上计算的指标显示其自身的 n n（FLIP 在 60 张图像上，PESQ 在 120 个语音输入上）。
